general.en: Authentic union and value-driven choice stand at the center. Align head, heart, and daily conduct so you move forward whole.
general.zh: 真诚连结与忠于价值的抉择居于核心。让理智、情感与日常行动归于一致，你才能整全地向前迈步。

love.en: In love, The Lovers signifies vivid mutual attraction paired with conscious devotion—choosing each other openly, communicating without masks, and honoring shared ethics.
love.zh: 在感情中，恋人象征炽热吸引与清醒承诺的结合——摘下面具坦诚相对，在共同价值观之上主动选择彼此。

career.en: At work, this signals a high-trust partnership, a role that fits your true calling, or a decisive career fork. Pick the collaboration whose principles you respect, not only the richest title.
career.zh: 在事业上，它预示高度互信的合伙关系、契合志趣的方向，或关键职业分岔口。选那个让你打心底认同其原则的合作，而不只盯着头衔。

health.en: For wellbeing, harmony between daily choices and physical needs matters—stop waging silent war against your own body and commit to care you genuinely respect.
health.zh: 在身心状态上，让日常选择与身体真实需求达成和解——停止暗中和自己的身体较劲，投入真正尊重自身节律的养护。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, union begins inside: reconciling opposing impulses—desire and conscience, mind and instinct—into one honest life.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，合一始于内在整合：让欲望与良知、头脑与直觉不再互相拉扯，汇成诚实而统一的生活。

core.en: The Lovers reversed reveals inner division or mismatched alignment—hesitating at a crossroads, compromising core values to keep peace, or drifting in a bond whose rhythms no longer match.
core.zh: 恋人逆位映照出内在分裂与价值错位——在路口迟疑摇摆、为了维持表面和谐委屈核心底线，或一段原本契合的关系正出现明显失调。

blocked.en: Indecision at a fork keeps you half-in and half-out, draining energy from every option.
blocked.zh: 在岔路口迟迟不落子，让你对每条路都只投入一半精力，两边落空。

excess.en: Chasing chemistry or immediate temptation while ignoring glaring mismatches in values.
excess.zh: 被一时悸动或眼前诱惑牵走，刻意忽略了深层价值观的明显错位。

internalized.en: Self-betrayal—agreeing outwardly while quietly resenting what you traded away inside.
internalized.zh: 向外勉强妥协点头，内心却在默默怨怼自己又一次出卖了真实心意。

release.en: Admitting a mismatch cleanly and reclaiming inner integrity instead of forcing harmony.
release.zh: 坦然承认不再合拍，收回勉强维系的精力，重新站回忠于自我的位置。

message.en: Stop agreeing to things that go against what you value. Name the mismatch honestly, to yourself first, and let the decision follow from that rather than from the wish to keep the peace.
message.zh: 别再对违背自己价值的事点头了。先对自己老实说出哪里不合拍，再让决定从这份诚实里长出来，而不是从“别伤和气”的愿望里长出来。

foundation.en: Somewhere back, you said yes while meaning maybe, or put off choosing until the choice was half made for you. That compromise, or that avoided decision, is what the present strain grows from.
foundation.zh: 回头看，你曾在心里还犹豫的时候就点了头，或者把选择一拖再拖，直到它被形势替你做了一半。眼下的拉扯，正是从那次妥协、或那次没做的决定里长出来的。

present.en: Two things that should match currently do not: what you say and what you want, your pace and theirs, or two options you keep trying to hold at once. The result is half-commitment on every side.
present.zh: 本该对得上的两样东西，现在对不上：你嘴上说的和心里要的，你的步调和对方的步调，或者两个你总想同时抓住的选项。结果就是哪一头都只投入了一半。

challenge.en: Conflicting desires, unclear priorities, or a misaligned partnership is pulling your focus in two directions.
challenge.zh: 相互打架的欲望、模糊不清的取舍或步调失和的关系，正把你的心力扯向两个相反方向。

resource.en: The discomfort is useful: it shows exactly where your values have been crossed. You also still hold the freedom to choose, and admitting that something does not fit may come as a relief to both sides.
resource.zh: 这份不舒服是有用的：它准确地标出了你的价值在哪里被越了线。选择的自由也仍在你手里；承认“不合适”，对双方来说都可能是一种解脱。

action.en: Stop pretending two incompatible choices can both stay open; tell the honest truth about where values diverge and choose one ground.
action.zh: 别再假装两条互相排斥的路可以同时留着；坦诚说出价值分歧所在，然后稳稳选定一方立足。

outcome.en: If the mismatch goes unaddressed, lingering friction tends to force a candid reckoning—either realigning terms honestly or parting cleanly before resentment hardens.
outcome.zh: 如果错位一直不处理，持续的摩擦往往会倒逼一次直面摊牌——要么坦诚地重新对齐条件，要么在怨怼固化前体面分开。

advice.en: Repair self-trust before demanding harmony outside: once you honor your own compass, blurred choices sharpen quickly.
advice.zh: 在向外索求和谐前先修好对自己的信任：只要你肯诚实守住内在罗盘，模糊纠结的选择很快会清晰。

hidden.en: Unvoiced resentment is worth checking for. Going along with something on the surface while objecting underneath may be quietly eroding the connection, or pulling you toward a temptation that offers escape.
hidden.zh: 查查有没有没说出口的怨气。表面上顺着，心里却不同意，这可能正在悄悄磨损这段关系，或者把你推向某个看似能让人逃开的诱惑。

self.en: You arrive split: one foot in, one foot out, saying what keeps things smooth rather than what is true for you. You are not yet fully on your own side.
self.zh: 你是分成两半来的：一只脚在里面，一只脚在外面，说的是能让场面好看的话，而不是自己的真心话。你还没有完全站到自己这一边。

other.en: The other person may be running hot and cold: warm one week and distant the next, or agreeing without following through. It could reflect their own indecision, so look at the pattern rather than any single moment.
other.zh: 对方可能忽冷忽热：这个星期热络，下个星期疏远，或者答应了却没有下文。这也许反映的是他们自己拿不定主意，所以要看整体的规律，而不是某一个瞬间。

external.en: Outside pressures are pulling the pieces apart: competing loyalties, other people's opinions about what you should choose, or timing that puts two commitments in conflict. The setting does not make a clean choice easy.
external.zh: 外部压力正把局面往两边扯：彼此冲突的情分，旁人对你该怎么选的指指点点，或者时间上撞在一起的两份承诺。这样的处境下，想干脆利落地做选择并不容易。

hopes_fears.en: Part of you hopes the tension will resolve without anyone having to choose. The fear is that choosing honestly means losing someone, and that not choosing means slowly losing yourself.
hopes_fears.zh: 你希望这份拉扯能自己化解，谁都不必做选择；又怕诚实地选了就会失去某个人，而一直不选，失去的则是慢慢被磨掉的自己。

general.en: Check where you are splitting your integrity or stalling on an overdue decision. Re-anchor in your real values before signing on to anyone else's script.
general.zh: 检视自己是否在某个环节违心妥协，或拖着一个早该拍板的决定。先站回自己的真实原则，再决定要不要接别人的剧本。

love.en: In love, reversed Lovers flags mismatched commitment levels, mixed signals, or avoiding a candid talk about where the bond is going. Clear expectations beat lingering ambiguity.
love.zh: 在感情中，恋人逆位提示投入程度不对等、信号摇摆或回避谈清未来走向。干脆摊开真实期待，胜过在模糊拉扯里彼此内耗。

career.en: At work, watch for partnership friction, values clashing with company culture, or juggling conflicting commitments. Realign roles or step away from a deal that compromises your ethics.
career.zh: 在职场上，留意合伙分歧、个人理念与团队文化冲突，或同时答应了彼此牵制的事务。及时重定边界，远离让你违背底线的合作。

health.en: Inconsistent habits reflect an inner tug-of-war between short-term escape and long-term care; make peace with a realistic plan you actually want to keep.
health.zh: 在身心层面，反复破功往往源于即时逃避与长远爱护之间的内在拉锯；定一个真正让你心甘情愿配合的务实节奏。

spirituality.en: Heal the split between what you profess to value and how you live on ordinary Tuesdays; wholeness returns through honest micro-choices.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，弥合口头信念与日常行为之间的裂缝；整全感不在宏大口号里，而在每一个诚实的细微抉择中回到你身上。

promptSpec.suitAccent: warm rose-amber sunset gold, luminous pearl ivory, celestial crimson-gold wings, lush emerald foliage, deep midnight-indigo zenith
promptSpec.scene: Beneath a radiant burst of warm golden-ivory celestial light parting deep midnight-indigo clouds, ONE majestic Belle Epoque angel with sweeping crimson-and-burnished-gold feathered wings extends both hands gracefully downward in luminous benediction above an abundant moonlit garden. Standing face-to-face in the brightly illuminated foreground are TWO expressive human lovers draped loosely in flowing translucent pearl-ivory and antique-gold Art Nouveau silk sashes, gazing openly toward one another in unmistakable mutual choice and devotion. Along the left edge rises ONE lush emerald fruit tree with a slender gilded serpent coiled along its trunk; along the right edge stands ONE sculptural tree crowned with twelve small glowing golden flame-blossoms, while a pale sunlit-rose mountain peak rises neatly in the open central space between the pair. Crisp warm golden rim-light separates the sweeping celestial wings above and the twin luminous silhouettes below against deep indigo-emerald shadows.

requiredObjects.object: radiant winged celestial angel above
standing human lovers facing each other
fruit tree with coiled serpent on left
flaming tree with twelve golden blossoms on right

promptSpec.compositionNote: Classic vertical triad: grand glowing crimson-gold angel filling the upper sky above twin sunlit ivory figures framing a pale central mountain peak, creating an instantly iconic symmetrical silhouette at 64x96 thumbnail.

archetypeEssence.en: Directed momentum forged by harnessing competing drives under one calm, decisive helm.
archetypeEssence.zh: 以沉着意志驾驭对立冲动、化分歧为定向突破的果敢推进力。

en: Armored charioteer standing upright beneath a star-spangled midnight canopy
Twin crescent moons mounted on the shoulders and eight-pointed star crown on the brow
Carved stone chariot carriage bearing a golden winged solar disk across its front
Two sphinxes—one black and one white—resting side by side before the wheels without visible reins
Distant walled riverside city left behind as the journey drives forward
zh: 挺立于满缀星辰的深蓝华盖战车之中的披甲御者
双肩缀有弯月肩甲、额前佩戴八芒星冠的飒爽仪态
车前浮雕金色展翼日轮徽记的雕石战车
无需缰绳牵引、一黑一白并卧车前的两尊斯芬克斯
留在身后远方河岸边的城郭轮廓，标示毅然启程的姿态

en: Poised Belle Epoque charioteer in ornate silver-and-gold filigree armor with crescent-moon pauldrons and an eight-pointed star diadem
Marble-and-gold chariot topped by a billowing midnight-indigo silk canopy embroidered with luminous golden stars and fronted by an embossed winged sun disk
Slender gilded steering baton held upright in the charioteer's right hand, commanding motion without physical reins
Two contrasting Art Nouveau sphinxes resting side by side in the foreground—one glossy obsidian-indigo, one luminous moonlit ivory
Distant warm-lit walled riverside city receding under a deep starry twilight sky
zh: 身着银金雕花板甲、佩弯月肩甲与八芒星冠的笃定御者
覆有深蓝星辰丝绒华盖、车首浮雕鎏金展翼日轮的大理石战车
右手竖握的纤细古金指挥杖，无须缰绳即稳控方向
车前一黑曜石、一月白象牙并列伏卧的两尊新艺术风格斯芬克斯
远方暮色河畔灯火隐约的城墙剪影与深邃星幕

core.en: The Chariot drives forward through focus rather than luck: opposing impulses, competing stakeholders, or mixed emotions do not have to vanish before you move—you steer them by keeping your eyes locked on one destination.
core.zh: 战车的推进靠的不是运气，而是定力与聚焦：相反的情绪、拉锯的诉求或复杂阻力不必先全部消失你才能出发，只要握稳方向，就能把两股力量统御成向前的冲劲。

message.en: Take the helm firmly and set one clear course; disciplined momentum now will carry you cleanly past hesitation.
message.zh: 稳稳接过舵盘并定下唯一航向；此刻克制而聚焦的推进力，会带你干脆越过犹疑期。

foundation.en: Grit, ambition, or a decisive departure from a safe familiar perimeter put you on this accelerating track.
foundation.zh: 你的硬气担当、进取野心或果断离开旧舒适区的决定，把你送上了眼下这条加速轨道。

present.en: Things are moving fast and responding directly to your command; hold your composure so speed turns into precision rather than drift.
present.zh: 局面正快速推进并紧跟你的指令；守住沉着定力，速度就会变成精准突破而非失控漂移。

challenge.en: Watch for treating every conversation as a race to win, or for pushing speed ahead of alignment.
challenge.zh: 别把每场互动都当成必须压倒对手的竞速，也别让冲刺跑在方向校准之前。

resource.en: Your strongest asset is self-mastery under tension—holding logic and emotion in the same harness instead of letting either hijack the wheel.
resource.zh: 你最大的筹码是高压下的自我驾驭力——能把理智与热血套进同一副车轭，不让任何一方夺走方向盘。

action.en: Lock in one concrete target, silence side distractions, and execute a decisive sprint that moves the needle visibly.
action.zh: 锁定一个具体靶心，清掉支线干扰，打出一场能让局面明显前移的果断冲刺。

outcome.en: Held steadily, this course tends toward an earned victory and open ground ahead; you are likely to break out of stalemate under your own disciplined drive.
outcome.zh: 只要稳住这股有章法的冲劲，局面倾向于迎来凭实力赢得的胜利与开阔新局；你很可能靠自己的定力与执行冲出僵局。

advice.en: Steer with quiet authority, not frantic whips—notice the sphinxes have no reins; inner clarity is what keeps opposing forces moving together.
advice.zh: 以沉静威仪而非焦躁挥鞭来御车——战车本无实体缰绳，真正让两股相反力量齐头并进的，是你不动摇的内在方向感。

hidden.en: Look at what is actually driving the push. Beneath the clear goal there may be opposing motives held together by willpower, or a need to prove something that has not been admitted.
hidden.zh: 看看这股冲劲背后到底是什么在驱动。在明确的目标底下，也许是靠意志力硬拢在一起的相反动机，或者一份没有承认的、想证明点什么的需要。

self.en: You show up determined and in control of yourself: armored, focused on the destination, unwilling to be talked off course. You bring discipline and nerve, and you expect to win this by effort.
self.zh: 你是带着决心和自制出场的：披着铠甲，盯着目的地，不肯被人劝得改了道。你带来的是纪律和胆气，也认定这件事要靠努力拿下。

other.en: They appear driven and sure of their direction, moving fast toward a goal of their own. They are likely to respect decisiveness, and may come across as guarded while they are in motion.
other.zh: 对方显得干劲十足、方向明确，正朝着自己的目标快速推进。他们多半欣赏果断的人；在赶路的时候，可能会给人一种不太容易接近的印象。

external.en: Events are moving quickly and in a clear direction: deadlines, travel, competition, a campaign already under way. The pace is set from outside, and it favors whoever stays focused.
external.zh: 外部的事态推进得很快，方向也清楚：最后期限，出行，竞争，一场已经打响的行动。节奏是外面定的，谁能保持专注，谁就更占便宜。

hopes_fears.en: You hope to drive this through to a clear win by sheer focus, yet fear that the forces you are holding together will pull apart the moment you relax your hold.
hopes_fears.zh: 你希望靠着一股专注把这件事一路推到明明白白的胜利；又怕手上稍微一松，被你拢在一起的那几股力量就各奔东西。

general.en: Determination, travel, and disciplined progress propel this chapter. Unite conflicting motives around a single clear objective and keep moving.
general.zh: 笃定意志、启程位移与有章法的推进主导当前阶段。把互相拉扯的念头收束到同一个清晰目标上，持续前进。

love.en: In love, The Chariot signals intentional momentum—moving a relationship forward decisively, bridging distance, or aligning two distinct personalities toward a shared horizon.
love.zh: 在感情中，战车意味清晰推进——主动打破停滞、跨越现实距离，或让两个性格鲜明的人对齐同一个共同方向。

career.en: At work, this favors ambitious sprints, competitive bids, relocation, launches, and taking command of complex cross-functional efforts. Keep milestones tight and drive through bottlenecks.
career.zh: 在事业上，极为有利冲刺攻坚、竞标突围、跨城发展、项目发布与统合复杂跨团队协作。盯紧节点，一口气冲破卡点。

health.en: For wellbeing, directed athletic energy and goal-driven stamina run high—channel that drive into purposeful training while respecting warm-up and recovery margins.
health.zh: 在身心状态上，充沛的行动力与目标感正处高点——适合把劲头投入有计划的体能提升，同时留足热身与恢复余量。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, discipline liberates: mastering reactive impulses lets deep conviction carry you across threshold moments unshaken.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，自律带来真正的自由：驾驭住摇摆不定的习气，深层信念才能载着你稳渡关键关口。

core.en: The Chariot reversed points to wheels spinning without traction—either forcing speed with no clear destination, or letting conflicting inner drives pull the carriage off course.
core.zh: 战车逆位指向车轮空转与方向失焦——要么在没看清终点前猛踩油门硬冲，要么内在两股拉扯之力各奔东西、把节奏拽偏。

blocked.en: Stalled momentum because competing goals or outside delays have locked the axles.
blocked.zh: 彼此冲突的目标或外部延误卡住了车轴，让原本该推进的事停在原地。

excess.en: Aggressive bulldozing, impatience, or confusing sheer velocity with actual progress.
excess.zh: 急躁硬冲、强行碾压，把盲目赶速度误当成了真正的进展。

internalized.en: Feeling privately pulled in opposite directions while trying to project relentless drive.
internalized.zh: 外表竭力维持雷厉风行的冲劲，内心却正被两股相反诉求撕扯得精疲力竭。

release.en: Stepping off the accelerator long enough to recalibrate route and reclaim genuine control.
release.zh: 主动松开油门停靠片刻，重新校准路线，把失散的掌控权稳稳握回手里。

message.en: Settle the argument inside you before you push again. The effort is not lacking; what is missing is one destination that every part of you has agreed to.
message.zh: 再发力之前，先把心里那场争执了结。你不缺力气，缺的是一个让自己的每一部分都点头的目的地。

foundation.en: Some time ago you set off at speed before the route was settled, or kept going on willpower while part of you wanted something else. The loss of traction now began with that unresolved split.
foundation.zh: 早先，路线还没定好你就全速出发了，或者明明心里有一部分想要别的，却靠意志力硬撑着往前。现在的打滑，就是从那道没解决的分歧开始的。

present.en: Momentum has stalled or gone sideways. You may be working hard and covering little ground, or held up by delays outside your control while two priorities compete for the driver's seat.
present.zh: 势头要么停了，要么跑偏了。你可能很卖力却没走出多远，或者被自己左右不了的延误卡着，同时还有两个优先事项在抢方向盘。

challenge.en: Scattered direction, impatience, or trying to overpower an obstacle that actually needs steering is draining momentum.
challenge.zh: 目标发散、急于求成，或试图用蛮力撞开原本只需巧妙绕行的障碍，正在消耗推力。

resource.en: The drive is still there, and so is the stamina that got you this far. A stop is not a defeat: time off the accelerator gives you a chance to check the map and take the wheel back.
resource.zh: 那股冲劲还在，把你送到这里的耐力也还在。停下来不等于输：松开油门的这段时间，正好让你看看地图，把方向盘重新握回手里。

action.en: Pull over for a deliberate pit stop: cut competing priorities down to one route and settle the internal tug-of-war before accelerating again.
action.zh: 果断进站检修片刻：把互相打架的优先级削减到唯一主线，先平息内在拉锯，再重新提速。

outcome.en: Forcing the pace invites detours or friction; once direction is reset cleanly, smooth travel resumes.
outcome.zh: 硬踩油门只会带来绕路与剐蹭；只要把方向重新归位，顺畅的推进感很快就会回来。

advice.en: Direction beats speed—slow down long enough to get both sphinxes facing the same horizon.
advice.zh: 方向永远重于速度——宁可先放慢半拍，让两尊斯芬克斯真正望向同一片地平线。

hidden.en: Ask whether part of you does not want to arrive. A private pull in the opposite direction, or doubt about the goal itself, may be braking the effort while you present full commitment.
hidden.zh: 问问自己，是不是有一部分的你并不想抵达。一股私下里朝反方向的拉力，或者对目标本身的怀疑，可能正在给这番努力踩刹车，而你对外表现出的却是全力以赴。

self.en: You appear either to be forcing the pace or to have lost your grip on it: impatient, pushing past people, or worn down from holding a determined face over real inner conflict.
self.zh: 你给人的样子要么是在硬赶进度，要么是已经握不住节奏：不耐烦，从别人身边硬挤过去，或者心里明明在打架，脸上还得撑出坚定的样子，已经累得不行。

other.en: The other party may be pressing ahead without consulting anyone, or stalling while insisting everything is on track. Their direction looks unsettled, so confirm where they are headed before matching their speed.
other.zh: 对方可能谁也不商量就往前冲，或者一边原地不动、一边坚称一切按计划进行。他们的方向看上去并不稳定，所以在跟上他们的速度之前，先确认他们要去哪里。

external.en: Outside conditions are slowing things down: transport or scheduling problems, stakeholders pulling different ways, a contest with no clear finish line. Pushing harder against these mostly burns fuel.
external.zh: 外部条件在拖慢进度：交通或排期出了问题，相关各方各拉各的，或者是一场看不清终点线的比拼。顶着这些硬加力，多半只是白烧油。

hopes_fears.en: You hope that one more hard push will break the deadlock, yet fear that stopping to rethink would look like giving up, or reveal that you were heading the wrong way.
hopes_fears.zh: 你希望再狠狠推一把就能打破僵局；又怕停下来重新想一想会被看成放弃，或者让人发现你原来一直走错了方向。

general.en: Ease off brute force and check your steering. Realign scattered efforts and check travel or schedule bottlenecks before pushing harder.
general.zh: 松开蛮力硬顶，先检查方向盘。把四散的精力重新归拢，并留意行程或排期卡点，确认路线无误再发力。

love.en: In love, reversed Chariot reveals mismatched pacing—one side rushing while the other brakes, or stubbornly trying to steer a partner. Pause to sync destinations together.
love.zh: 在感情中，战车逆位暴露步调错位——一方猛推而另一方急刹，或试图单方主导关系节奏。先停下来把彼此想去的地方对齐。

career.en: At work, watch for scope sprawl, missed handoffs, or burnout from sprinting in conflicting directions. Re-establish one clear roadmap and trim side battles.
career.zh: 在职场上，警惕方向摇摆、衔接失误，或在彼此抵消的任务里透支冲刺。重新明确一张主路线图，砍掉消耗精力的支线争执。

health.en: Pushing past fatigue or ignoring tension invites minor strain; dial back intensity and rebuild steady pacing before resuming full speed.
health.zh: 在身心层面，无视疲惫硬撑加速容易带来劳损；主动降速调匀呼吸与作息，比硬冲更能跑完长程。

spirituality.en: Notice where willpower has hardened into ego urgency; true mastery knows when to pause and let resistance settle.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，觉察意志力是否已滑向焦躁的自我执念；真正的驾驭懂得何时勒马，让内在阻力先沉淀平息。

promptSpec.suitAccent: celestial royal blue, burnished antique gold, polished silver-ivory, velvety obsidian, deep midnight-indigo shadows
promptSpec.scene: A poised, determined Belle Epoque charioteer stands tall inside a sculpted pale-marble and antique-gold ceremonial chariot beneath a billowing midnight-indigo silk canopy embroidered with luminous golden stars. Wearing intricately engraved silver-and-gold ornamental plate armor with twin curved crescent-moon shoulder guards and an eight-pointed star diadem, the charioteer holds ONE slender gilded baton upright in the right hand with calm sovereign command. Across the bright front facade of the marble chariot gleams an embossed golden winged sun disk flanked by ornate spoked wheels. Resting side by side directly before the carriage are EXACTLY TWO regal stone-carved Art Nouveau winged lion guardians facing calmly outward—the left sculpted in glossy obsidian-indigo stone with gold collar, the right in luminous moonlit ivory marble with gold collar—creating unmistakable dark-and-light duality. Far behind the chariot glows the warm silhouette of a walled riverside city beneath a sweeping starry twilight sky.

requiredObjects.object: armored charioteer standing inside chariot
starry canopy chariot with embossed winged sun disk
glossy obsidian black sphinx
luminous ivory white sphinx
gilded steering baton in right hand

promptSpec.compositionNote: Tall regal armored figure framed under a dark starry canopy box, centered directly above crisp black-and-white twin sphinxes flanking a bright winged-disk carriage front—instant contrast and recognition at 64x96 thumbnail.

archetypeEssence.en: Gentle, unhurried courage that befriends fierce instinct through warmth and presence rather than force.
archetypeEssence.zh: 以温厚与定力安抚野性本能的柔韧勇气，不靠强压征服，而以信任化刚为柔。

en: Serene woman draped in white robes girdled with blooming flowers and vines
Glowing infinity lemniscate suspended lightly above her flower-wreathed brow
Powerful red-orange lion leaning calmly beneath her gentle, unafraid hands
Unarmed, unhurried touch resting on the lion's jaws and mane showing mastery without weapons
Warm open meadow stretching toward a quiet blue-violet peak in the distance
zh: 身着素白长裙、以鲜花藤蔓束腰的沉静女子
轻盈悬浮在花冠额际上方、泛着微光的无限符号
在她柔和而不设防的双手间温顺依偎的雄壮橙红色狮子
不借刀剑锁链、仅以温柔触碰安抚狮吻的从容力量
向远方淡紫远山舒展开来的明亮开阔草野

en: Serene Belle Epoque woman in a flowing moonlit-ivory silk gown wreathed with blooming crimson roses and golden wildflowers
Glowing molten-gold infinity lemniscate hovering crisply above her dark flower-crowned hair against deep midnight-indigo sky
Magnificent golden-maned lion with sinuous Klimt-styled curling locks leaning trustingly into her tender hands
Warm amber-gold twilight backlighting separating her luminous white drapery and the lion's tawny mane from twilight hills
Blooming crimson rose meadow stretching peacefully toward distant indigo mountain ridges
zh: 身着月白丝绸长裙、腰间发际缀满深红玫瑰与金花的美好年代女子
在深邃午夜蓝天幕下闪耀于花冠上方的熔金无限符号
鬃毛如克里姆特金卷般流淌、温顺伏近她柔韧双手的雄伟金狮
勾勒出洁白衣袖、温暖掌心与狮子金鬃的琥珀色暮光逆光轮廓
向远方靛青群山延展的盛放红玫瑰与野花草坡

core.en: Strength shows real power that never has to shout: meet fear, anger, desire, or a volatile situation with calm steadiness and compassionate nerve, and fierce energy turns into a loyal ally.
core.zh: 力量展现的是无需声嘶力竭的真正底气：面对恐惧、怒意、欲望或棘手局面时，以沉静稳健的温厚气场去承接而非硬碰硬，凶猛的能量就会化为你最忠实的盟友。

message.en: Lead with calm nerve and patience rather than intimidation; gentleness paired with spine will unlock what brute push cannot.
message.zh: 用沉着胆识与耐心去化局，别靠施压硬顶；有脊梁的温和能解开蛮力撞不开的结。

foundation.en: Quiet resilience, emotional maturity, or surviving an earlier test without losing your warmth built the ground under your feet.
foundation.zh: 过往默默扛过的考验、日渐成熟的情绪定力，以及历经风波仍保有的温热善意，铸成了你此刻的底气。

present.en: You are handling high-stakes heat well—staying steady, listening deeply, and trusting slow influence over reactive control.
present.zh: 你正稳稳接住当下的高热局面——保持呼吸平稳、真诚倾听，相信润物无声的影响力胜过焦躁硬控。

challenge.en: Ask whether endless patience is bordering on absorbing too much friction alone—remember compassion includes firm limits.
challenge.zh: 无止境的包容，是否快演变成独自吞下所有摩擦？别忘了，慈悲同样包含清晰底线。

resource.en: Your greatest asset is heart-centered composure: courage that can sit right beside fierce feelings without flinching or lashing out.
resource.zh: 你最强的资本是源于内心的笃定与定力——敢直面剧烈情绪与强劲对手，既不退缩也不失态反击。

action.en: De-escalate one tense dynamic today through steady eye contact, honest warmth, and calm persistence rather than raising the volume.
action.zh: 今天用平稳目光、真诚善意与不卑不亢的坚持，把一处紧绷僵局柔和化解，不必靠提高音量证明立场。

outcome.en: If you keep meeting this with calm steadiness, lasting mastery and deep trust are likely to emerge, and a tough challenge tends to soften into durable respect and inner steadiness.
outcome.zh: 只要继续以沉静定力应对，长久的掌控感与深厚信赖很可能浮现，棘手的考验也往往会软化为持久的尊重与内在的从容。

advice.en: Befriend your own fierceness instead of caging it; passion guided by tenderness becomes unstoppable stamina.
advice.zh: 与内心那头狮子成为朋友，而不是把它关进笼子；被温柔引路的野性与热情，会化为源源不绝的耐力。

hidden.en: A strong feeling may be present that has been handled so smoothly nobody has remarked on it: anger, desire, or fear held gently in check. Check what you are quietly containing, and what it needs.
hidden.zh: 也许有一股强烈的情绪被处理得太平顺，以至于没人提起：被轻轻按住的怒气、欲望或恐惧。看看你在默默包容着什么，它又需要什么。

self.en: You meet this with steady nerves and an open hand: patient, kind without being a pushover, able to stay near strong emotion without being run by it.
self.zh: 你是带着稳得住的心、不攥拳头的手来面对这件事的：有耐心，待人和善却不软弱，能待在强烈的情绪旁边，而不被它牵着走。

other.en: Across from you is someone who appears calm and patient under pressure, likely stronger than their gentle manner suggests. They seem to answer provocation with restraint, and may be handling more than they show.
other.zh: 对方在压力之下显得平静而有耐心，实际的分量多半比温和的举止看上去要重。面对挑衅，他们似乎以克制回应，承担的东西可能也比表现出来的多。

external.en: The situation outside is charged, and it responds to patience rather than force: a volatile person, a tense room, a long test of endurance. Those around you are watching how you carry yourself under strain.
external.zh: 外面的局势带着火药味，而它吃软不吃硬：一个容易失控的人，一屋子紧绷的气氛，或者一场比拼耐力的持久考验。周围的人也在看你在压力之下如何自处。

hopes_fears.en: Your hope is that patience and goodwill will be enough to calm this. Your fear is the day your own temper or appetite gets loose, or that kindness will be mistaken for weakness.
hopes_fears.zh: 你希望凭着耐心和善意就足以把局面安抚下来；又怕哪天自己的脾气或欲望挣脱出来，或者这份温和被人当成软弱。

general.en: Quiet courage, patience, and emotional poise carry the day. Meet intensity with steady warmth and let endurance outlast impulse.
general.zh: 沉静勇气、耐心与情绪定力主导此刻。用温厚定力承接高强度场面，让持久耐力胜过一时冲动。

love.en: In love, Strength blends passion with deep tenderness—holding space for raw honesty, calming reactive storms together, and trusting loyalty built on kindness rather than control.
love.zh: 在感情中，力量将炽热吸引与深层体贴融为一体——接住彼此真实的脆弱与脾气，共同平息情绪风浪，用善意而非操控建立牢不可破的信赖。

career.en: At work, influence comes through composure under pressure, diplomatic firmness, and staying steady through complex negotiations or tough leadership moments.
career.zh: 在职场上，你的分量来自高压下的从容气场、柔中带刚的斡旋力，以及在复杂谈判或艰难时刻稳住阵脚的担当。

health.en: For wellbeing, vitality grows through consistent, compassionate conditioning and nervous-system regulation—working with your body's instincts instead of punishing it.
health.zh: 在身心状态上，生命力源于温和而持续的体能滋养与神经系统安定——顺应身体本能去调养强健，而非靠苛刻鞭策消耗它。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, real devotion integrates raw human nature rather than suppressing it—fear, longing, and pride transform when met with fearless compassion.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，真正的修行不是压抑人性本能，而是全然整合——当恐惧、渴望与傲气被无畏的慈悲轻托住时，它们自会转化为觉醒之力。

core.en: Strength reversed points to depleted inner reserve—either self-doubt and exhaustion muting your nerve, or bottled-up intensity spilling out as sharp impatience.
core.zh: 力量逆位提示内在续航告急——要么疲惫与自我怀疑压低了你的胆气，要么长久压抑的焦躁与怒火濒临失控外溢。

blocked.en: Fatigue or eroded confidence makes an ordinary hurdle feel twice its actual size.
blocked.zh: 精力见底或自信受损，让原本跨得过去的坎显得比实际沉重一倍。

excess.en: Snapping under stress, forcing outcomes through brute pride, or letting raw impulse grab the wheel.
excess.zh: 在压力下骤然发火、靠好胜蛮力硬压局面，或任由冲动情绪接管方向。

internalized.en: Swallowing frustration to look saintly while quietly eroding your own vitality inside.
internalized.zh: 为了维持大度体面把委屈与怒意全吞回肚子里，暗中消耗着自己的元气。

release.en: Admitting you are human and tired—rebuilding genuine resilience through honest rest instead of white-knuckling.
release.zh: 坦然承认自己此刻累了——放下咬牙硬撑的体面，借由诚实休养重新养回真底气。

message.en: You are more tired than you are admitting. Stop measuring yourself against how much you can endure, and treat rest as part of handling this rather than a retreat from it.
message.zh: 你比自己肯承认的更累。别再拿“能忍多少”来衡量自己了；把休息看成应对这件事的一部分，而不是从这件事里退缩。

foundation.en: You held it together for a long time by biting back what you felt, or pushed through on pride after the energy had gone. The short fuse or flat confidence of today was built up over that stretch.
foundation.zh: 很长一段时间里，你是靠把话忍回去才撑住的，或者劲早就用完了，还凭着一口好强的气硬顶。今天一点就着的脾气、提不起来的信心，都是那段日子攒下的。

present.en: Reserves are low right now. Ordinary demands feel heavier than they should, patience runs out quickly, and you may be swinging between going quiet and snapping.
present.zh: 此刻的储备很低。平常的要求也显得格外沉，耐心很快就见底，你可能在闷不作声和突然发火之间来回摆。

challenge.en: Low emotional bandwidth, self-doubt, or reactive impatience is undercutting your usual poise.
challenge.zh: 情绪带宽见底、自我怀疑或压不住的急躁，正在折损你一向稳健的判断力。

resource.en: What you have left is honesty about your limits, and that is worth a lot. The endurance you have already shown is proof of capacity; admitting you need to recover is what lets it rebuild.
resource.zh: 你还剩下的，是对自身限度的诚实，而这很值钱。你已经撑过的那些，就是能力的证明；承认自己需要恢复，才能让这份力气重新长回来。

action.en: Step back before answering a trigger, replenish basic physical stamina first, and name one small boundary cleanly instead of bottling it.
action.zh: 遇到刺激点先缓一拍再回话，优先补回基本体能与睡眠，并把一条小边界坦白说出来，别继续闷在心里。

outcome.en: Trying to push through empty reserves leads to frayed nerves; pausing to steady yourself restores real grit quickly.
outcome.zh: 空着油箱硬顶只会让神经愈发紧绷；肯停下来稳住元气，那份从容韧劲很快就会回到你身上。

advice.en: Courage right now looks like self-kindness—stop grading yourself harshly for feeling raw and recharge before re-entering the arena.
advice.zh: 此刻最需要的是善待自己的勇气——别因为感到脆弱或烦躁而严厉苛责自己，先充好电再回赛场。

hidden.en: Check what you have been swallowing to keep up a composed front. Unspoken frustration or a doubt about your own courage may be draining more energy than the situation itself.
hidden.zh: 看看你为了维持镇定的门面，一直在咽下些什么。没说出口的憋屈，或者对自己勇气的怀疑，耗掉的精力可能比事情本身还多。

self.en: You feel smaller than the task at hand: doubting your nerve, bracing for a fight, or performing a calm you do not have. You may be harder on yourself than the situation calls for.
self.zh: 你觉得自己比这件事矮了一截：怀疑自己的胆量，时刻准备着干一仗，或者装出一份其实没有的平静。你对自己的苛刻，可能已经超出了这件事所需要的程度。

other.en: The other person may be running on empty: irritable, quick to take offense, or pulling back without explanation. Their sharpness appears to be about strain, so avoid meeting it with force.
other.zh: 对方可能已经撑到了极限：烦躁，容易被冒犯，或者不作解释地往后缩。他们的尖刻看起来更像是压力所致，所以别用硬碰硬去回应。

external.en: The demands coming at you are relentless, and the people around you have little patience to spare. It is an atmosphere of short tempers and long hours, where small provocations land harder than usual.
external.zh: 冲着你来的要求一刻不停，周围的人也没有多少耐心可以匀给你。这是一种人人火气大、个个熬得久的氛围，一点小小的刺激都比平时更扎人。

hopes_fears.en: You hope to get your confidence and calm back, yet fear that you no longer have it in you, or that if you stop holding everything in, what comes out will be too much.
hopes_fears.zh: 你希望找回原来的自信和平静；又怕自己已经没有那份力气了，或者一旦不再把一切都憋着，涌出来的东西会让人承受不住。

general.en: Check your emotional fuel gauge before taking on another battle. Rebuilding quiet self-trust matters more than performing invincibility.
general.zh: 再接下一场硬仗前，先看看自己的情绪电量表。此刻重建踏实的自我信任，比硬撑出无坚不摧的样子更重要。

love.en: In love, reversed Strength flags insecurity, jealousy, or snapping out of exhaustion rather than malice. Name your tender spot honestly before pride turns it into an argument.
love.zh: 在感情中，力量逆位提示敏感不安、醋意或因透支而脱口而出的锋利语气。在自尊心把脆点拧成争吵前，先坦白说清你的在意与疲惫。

career.en: At work, imposter doubts or short-tempered micromanaging signal burnout. Pace your stamina, delegate where you can, and avoid making sharp decisions while depleted.
career.zh: 在职场上，自我怀疑或耐性见底的急躁反应往往是过劳警报。稳住节奏、能放手的就分担出去，别在精力枯竭时做关键拍板。

health.en: Low stamina and heightened stress reactivity ask for genuine recovery—prioritize sleep, nutrition, and gentle unloading rather than heroic willpower.
health.zh: 在身心层面，体能下滑与应激敏感都在呼唤切实休养——把睡眠、营养与舒压排在首位，别再拿意志力透支身体。

spirituality.en: Meet your inner shadow without shame; pretending you never feel anger or fear only hands them the keys behind your back.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，不带羞耻地正视内在阴影；假装自己永远不会愤怒或胆怯，反而会让压抑的情绪在背后悄悄掌权。

promptSpec.suitAccent: molten sunlit amber-gold, crimson-rose blossoms, luminous warm ivory, deep midnight-indigo horizon shadows
promptSpec.scene: In a luminous twilight-meets-dawn meadow carpeted with blooming crimson roses and golden wildflowers, ONE serene Belle Epoque woman in a graceful full-length moonlit-ivory silk gown girdled with trailing rose garlands stands calmly beside ONE magnificent golden-maned lion. With unhurried gentleness and complete composure, both of her warmly lit hands rest softly upon the great lion brow and golden mane as the lion leans peacefully into her calm touch with gentle eyes. Hovering crisply above her flower-wreathed hair gleams ONE glowing molten-gold infinity lemniscate silhouetted cleanly against the velvety midnight-indigo upper sky. Radiant warm amber dawn light catches the lion sinuous Klimt-styled curling golden mane, her ivory silk sleeves, and distant twilight mountain ridges.

requiredObjects.object: serene woman in white silk gown
magnificent golden-maned lion
floating golden infinity lemniscate above her head

promptSpec.compositionNote: Graceful curving embrace between bright ivory-robed woman and rich golden lion centered cleanly in the frame, crowned by a distinct floating golden lemniscate against dark indigo sky—warm and legible at 64x96 thumbnail.

archetypeEssence.en: Deliberate solitude and honest self-inquiry—carrying enough steady light for the next true step.
archetypeEssence.zh: 主动选择的沉静独处与深层省思——手提一盏明灯，先照清脚下最真实的那一步。

en: Hooded bearded elder standing calmly atop a snowy mountain ridge under a dark sky
Raised brass lantern holding a blazing six-pointed golden star of inner truth
Tall wooden pilgrim staff gripped steadily in the left hand for grounded balance
Heavy muted cloak turned slightly inward and downward in unhurried contemplation
Vast silent mountain range receding below the solitary summit
zh: 独步覆雪险峰、立于静谧夜空之下的连帽白须长者
右手高举、内蕴熠熠六芒星火的提灯，象征内在真知
左手稳拄、支撑山路步履的修长行者木杖
披覆厚重素袍、微微俯首沉思的内敛身影
脚下层叠沉寂、向远方延展的苍茫群山

en: Solitary silver-bearded Belle Epoque sage in three-quarter profile wrapped in a draped slate-indigo and antique-gold hooded cloak
Ornate brass-and-glass Art Nouveau lantern held aloft in the right hand containing a blazing golden six-pointed star
Warm ivory-gold lantern radiance illuminating the sage's contemplative brow, outstretched hand, and snow-rimmed crag
Tall gilded oak pilgrim staff planted steadily in the left hand along the alpine ridge
Expansive nocturnal mountain peaks fading into silvery twilight mist under a starry midnight-indigo sky
zh: 身披灰靛鎏金连帽斗篷、侧颜沉静的银须美好年代智者
右手向夜色高举、内嵌耀眼六芒金星的新艺术风格黄铜玻璃提灯
暖金灯光清晰照亮智者沉思的眉眼、手背与覆雪崖石
左手稳稳拄在冰岩山脊上的修长鎏金橡木行杖
星幕深蓝下隐入银蓝薄雾的辽阔群峰剪影

core.en: The Hermit asks you to step out of the crowd's noise so you can hear your own honest verdict. You do not need the entire map illuminated at once—only enough clear lantern light to verify the very next step.
core.zh: 隐士请你暂时离开人群喧哗，听清自己最诚实的判断。你不必一口气看穿千里之外的整张地图——手里这盏提灯只要照亮眼前这一步，就足以让你走得踏实。

message.en: Take deliberate quiet time before answering; genuine clarity right now comes from stepping back, not asking five more people.
message.zh: 回应之前先给自己留出一段刻意的独处空白；此刻真正的清醒来自退后沉淀，而不是再去多问五个人。

foundation.en: A season of study, introspection, or solitary self-reliance quietly forged the wisdom you stand on now.
foundation.zh: 一段埋头深研、独自消化或独立撑过低谷的沉潜期，悄悄打磨出了你如今的洞察力。

present.en: You are in a contemplative pause—auditing what truly holds value and letting hollow distractions fall away naturally.
present.zh: 你正处在一场高质量的沉思窗口——逐项审视哪些事真正值得投入，让浮躁杂音自行褪去。

challenge.en: Self-sufficiency can quietly slide into aloofness, making it hard for genuine allies to reach you.
challenge.zh: 习惯凡事独自想通，可能不知不觉演变成疏离戒备，让真心想帮你的伙伴无从靠近。

resource.en: Your strongest asset is hard-won discernment and deep focus—the ability to examine a problem patiently until its true grain appears.
resource.zh: 你最强的优势是沉得住气的独立思辨——愿意顺着问题的纹理耐心拆解，直到看清核心本质。

action.en: Carve out an uninterrupted block of solitude—turn off feeds, review the real facts slowly, and write down one honest conclusion.
action.zh: 专门划出一段不被打扰的独处时光——关掉信息流、慢慢复盘真实脉络，亲手写下一条毫无自欺的结论。

outcome.en: Given unhurried reflection, this course tends toward quiet, steady clarity: you are likely to emerge knowing your own mind and able to light the path for others too.
outcome.zh: 只要给足沉淀的时间，这条路倾向于带来沉稳而踏实的内在笃定：你很可能想明白自己的方向，也能为后来者举起一盏灯。

advice.en: Respect your own pace: wisdom ripens in unhurried silence, and lighting one honest footstep beats chasing bright illusions.
advice.zh: 尊重自己慢下来的节律：真知往往在安静中成熟，照实走稳脚下这一步，远胜追逐华而不实的远景。

hidden.en: The answer may already be with you, reached in private and not yet acted on. Check what you concluded the last time you were alone with this, before other voices came back in.
hidden.zh: 答案也许早就在你这里了，是独处时得出的，只是还没照着去做。回想一下上一次你独自面对这件事、别人的声音还没涌回来时，你得出了什么结论。

self.en: You bring a thoughtful distance to this: self-reliant, careful, more interested in what is true than in what is popular. You prefer to work it out alone before you speak.
self.zh: 你带着一种深思熟虑的距离感来面对这件事：凡事靠自己，行事谨慎，在意什么是真的，胜过在意什么受欢迎。你习惯先独自想明白，再开口。

other.en: The other person appears to be keeping to themselves for now, which looks more like taking time to think than like avoidance. They may be slow to reply, and are probably best approached with patience and a specific question.
other.zh: 对方眼下显得不太露面，看起来更像是在花时间把事情想清楚，而不是在躲你。他们回复可能会慢一些，带着耐心和一个具体的问题去找他们，大概最合适。

external.en: It is a quiet period outside: few invitations, little feedback, long gaps between replies. The lack of company or noise is a condition of the moment, and it leaves room for careful study.
external.zh: 外面正处在一段安静期：邀约不多，反馈很少，回音之间隔得很久。少了陪伴和喧闹，是眼下这段时间的客观条件，也给细细钻研留出了余地。

hopes_fears.en: You hope time alone will bring a clear answer you can trust, yet fear the loneliness of it, or that what you find in the quiet will ask you to change more than you would like.
hopes_fears.zh: 你希望独处一段时间能换来一个自己信得过的清晰答案；又怕那份孤单，或者怕在安静里看见的东西，会要求你做出比自己愿意的更大的改变。

general.en: Reflection, research, and quiet self-counsel serve you better than hurried action. Step back from outside chatter and trust patient examination.
general.zh: 静心复盘、深度调研与独立思考此刻远胜仓促行动。暂时退离外界杂音，信任耐心求证得出的答案。

love.en: In love, The Hermit invites honest self-knowledge—taking space to understand your true emotional needs, or honoring a partner's quiet need to process without reading it as rejection.
love.zh: 在感情中，隐士指向诚实的自我觉察——给自己留出看清真实情感需求的空间，或体谅伴侣需要静一静消化的节奏，不急着将其解读为冷淡。

career.en: At work, this shines for deep research, specialist mastery, auditing, writing, and long-horizon strategy. Do the quiet unglamorous thinking nobody else slows down to finish.
career.zh: 在工作与学业上，这张牌极适合深度研究、专业精进、审计复盘、写作与长线战略思考。去完成那些旁人浮躁跳过的扎实功课。

health.en: For wellbeing, quiet decompression—reduced screen noise, solitary walks, earlier nights, and attentive pacing—restores nervous-system depth.
health.zh: 在身心调理上，低刺激的安静休整——减少屏幕杂讯、独自散步、提早入睡与温和节律——最能深层修复疲惫的神经。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, this is the classic pilgrimage inward: seek the quiet lamp of direct conscience rather than loud spectacles.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性修习上，这是经典的向内朝圣之路：远离喧闹表象，只追随内心那盏微亮却诚实的觉知之灯。

core.en: The Hermit reversed shows solitude tipping off balance—either lingering in protective isolation long past the point of insight, or fleeing quiet reflection because silence feels uncomfortable.
core.zh: 隐士逆位显示独处失去了恰当分寸——要么在早已想明白后仍躲在封闭孤岛里不愿出来，要么一味用忙碌喧闹逃避安静，不敢独自面对内心真话。

blocked.en: Withdrawing into stubborn loneliness and refusing perspective that could quickly unstick you.
blocked.zh: 缩回固执的孤立里闭门造车，把原本能立刻帮你破局的外部视角挡在门外。

excess.en: Over-analyzing in an echo chamber until quiet caution morphs into cynical paralysis.
excess.zh: 在自我回音室里反复钻牛角尖，让原本清醒的审慎变成了多疑与停滞。

internalized.en: Feeling unseen or cut off even while surrounded by everyday noise and obligations.
internalized.zh: 即便置身日常人潮与事务之中，内心却始终弥漫着无人懂得的孤寂感。

release.en: Descending the mountain at last—bringing hard-won insight back into warm human company.
release.zh: 终于提灯下山——把独处修来的清醒与温度重新带回真实的人间连结。

message.en: Time alone was meant to help you see, not to keep you out of reach. Notice whether you are hiding in solitude or hiding from it, and correct toward the side you have been avoiding.
message.zh: 独处本是为了让你看得更清楚，而不是让别人够不着你。看看你是在躲进独处，还是在躲开独处，然后朝自己一直回避的那一头调整过去。

foundation.en: A period of withdrawal went on past its usefulness, or you kept so busy that there was never a quiet hour to think. Either way, the reflection this needed was not finished or not shared.
foundation.zh: 之前有一段退避的日子，过了有用的期限还在继续；或者你一直忙得连一个钟头的清静都腾不出来。不管哪一种，这件事需要的那番思考，要么没做完，要么没跟人说。

present.en: At present you are either cut off or avoiding your own company. Thoughts circle without new input, or the calendar stays full so that nothing has to be faced; the balance between inward and outward is off.
present.zh: 眼下的你要么与人隔绝，要么在回避独处。念头没有新的输入，只在原地打转；或者日程排得满满的，好让什么都不必面对。向内和向外之间的平衡已经偏了。

challenge.en: Isolation, overthinking alone, or avoiding a quiet honest check-in with yourself is clouding perspective.
challenge.zh: 过度封闭、一个人钻死胡同，或刻意回避与自己坦诚独处，正在让视野变窄。

resource.en: The thinking you did alone was not wasted; there is real insight in it, ready to be tested in conversation. People who would listen are still within reach, and the path back down is open.
resource.zh: 你独自想过的那些并没有白费，里面有真见地，正等着拿到对话里去检验。愿意听你说的人仍然找得到，下山的路也一直开着。

action.en: Either step back into the room and share what you learned with one trusted ally, or turn off distractions for thirty minutes to face the thought you keep outrunning.
action.zh: 看清自己正偏向哪一端：若已闭门太久，就主动约一位信得过的人聊聊；若一直在逃避安静，就关掉干扰静坐半小时面对那个念头。

outcome.en: Prolonged withdrawal grows heavier if left unchecked; reconnecting selectively brings fresh air back into stagnant thought.
outcome.zh: 继续自我封闭只会让心事越积越重；有选择地重新连接外界，会立刻为停滞的思绪吹进清风。

advice.en: Solitude is a lantern, not a fortress—once reflection has done its work, step back down the trail and engage life again.
advice.zh: 独处是照明的灯，不是隔绝世界的堡垒——沉淀完成后，就该迈步下山重新走入生活。

hidden.en: Consider whether the distance is still about thinking, or has become a way to avoid being seen. A feeling of being unknown to the people around you may sit under the withdrawal, or under the constant busyness.
hidden.zh: 想一想：这份距离如今还是为了思考，还是已经变成了不让人看见自己的办法？在退避或不停的忙碌底下，也许压着一种“身边没人真正了解我”的感觉。

self.en: You are showing up withdrawn or evasive: hard to reach, sure that no one would understand, or keeping too busy to be asked a real question. The independence has started to cost you.
self.zh: 你呈现出来的是退缩或躲闪：很难联系上，认定没人会懂，或者忙得让别人问不出一句正经话。这份独立已经开始让你付出代价了。

other.en: The other person may be pulling away or shutting others out: unanswered messages, canceled plans, a closed door. It may equally be someone who cannot bear to be alone; in both cases, an easy, low-pressure invitation works better than a demand.
other.zh: 对方可能在往后退，或者把人挡在门外：消息不回，约好的事取消，门关着。也可能恰恰相反，是个受不了独处的人。无论哪种，一个轻松、没有压力的邀请，都比一句要求更管用。

external.en: Your surroundings make balance difficult: a setting that isolates you, with few people to compare notes with, or one so crowded and loud that there is no room to think.
external.zh: 你所处的环境让人很难找到平衡：要么把你孤立起来，找不到几个人可以交流看法；要么拥挤嘈杂，连想事情的地方都没有。

hopes_fears.en: You wish someone would reach in and understand without your having to explain, yet fear that coming out of your shell means being judged, and that staying in means being forgotten.
hopes_fears.zh: 你希望有人能主动走近、不用你解释就懂你；又怕走出自己的壳会被人评头论足，而一直待在里面，又会被人遗忘。

general.en: Check whether reflection has drifted into unhelpful isolation or whether busyness is drowning out needed quiet. Rebalance solitude with real human exchange.
general.zh: 确认当下的独处是否已滑向封闭孤立，或者反过来正在用忙碌逃避静思。在安静沉淀与真实交流之间重新校准平衡。

love.en: In love, reversed Hermit flags emotional distance, stonewalling, or staying guarded out of fear of repeating old loneliness. Reach out gently instead of disappearing into silence.
love.zh: 在感情中，隐士逆位提示情感退缩、冷沉默，或因害怕再次孤单而先一步筑墙。试着温和伸出手，别把沉默当成习惯性逃生通道。

career.en: At work, working too long in a silo risks missing critical feedback or turning down helpful collaborators. Share your draft early and invite seasoned outside eyes.
career.zh: 在职场上，长期单打独斗容易错失关键反馈或把帮手推远。尽早拿出阶段成果与团队校准，让外界视角帮你照出盲区。

health.en: Withdrawing from care, ignoring quiet fatigue, or ruminating alone late at night deepens strain; reach out for practical support and steady social rhythm.
health.zh: 在身心层面，独自硬扛不适、深夜反刍焦虑或回避求助都会加重耗损；主动寻求可靠陪伴与专业支持，帮自己走出低回圈。

spirituality.en: Beware spiritual isolation or subtle pride in standing apart; wisdom proves itself through everyday warmth and service.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，警惕以清高独处自居的隐性疏离；真正的洞见终究要在平凡人间的善意与承接中落地验证。

promptSpec.suitAccent: radiant warm star-gold lantern glow, frost-ivory snow highlights, slate-violet cloak, deep velvety midnight-indigo shadows
promptSpec.scene: High atop a craggy snow-dusted alpine peak beneath an expansive starry midnight-indigo sky, ONE solitary silver-bearded Belle Epoque sage stands in calm three-quarter profile wrapped in a heavily draped slate-indigo and burnished-gold hooded cloak. Extending their right arm forward into the crisp darkness, they lift ONE intricate brass-and-glass Art Nouveau lantern housing a brilliantly blazing golden six-pointed star whose warm ivory-gold radiance illuminates their weathered, contemplative brow, hand, cloak folds, and the icy rocky ledge immediately ahead. Their left hand rests steadily upon ONE tall, slender gilded oak pilgrim staff planted firmly against the dark stone crest. Far below, sweeping nocturnal mountain peaks recede into silvery indigo mist, isolating the tall hooded silhouette and glowing lantern star with dramatic theatrical chiaroscuro.

requiredObjects.object: hooded bearded Hermit figure
raised brass lantern containing blazing six-pointed golden star
tall wooden pilgrim staff

promptSpec.compositionNote: Tall dramatic vertical hooded silhouette against velvety dark starry sky with ONE intensely bright golden lantern star suspended in open upper-right negative space—instantly unmistakable focal glow even at 64x96 thumbnail.

archetypeEssence.en: Turning cycles and shifting tides where agile timing and grounded poise outperform rigid control.
archetypeEssence.zh: 周而复始的时运流转与关键拐点，顺势借力与定心应变远胜僵硬死守。

en: Great gilded cosmic wheel rotating freely amid sunlit clouds
Crowned blue sphinx poised calmly atop the wheel's summit holding a short blade
Jackal-headed figure rising up the right rim and sinuous serpent gliding down the left
Concentric rings and eight radial spokes uniting earthly seasons with celestial motion
Four winged corner creatures—angel, eagle, bull, and lion—holding open books in the clouds
zh: 凌空悬浮于云霞之间、缓缓旋转的宏大金色命运巨轮
稳坐轮顶、手执短剑、神情沉着的戴冠蓝色斯芬克斯
沿轮缘右侧向上攀升的胡狼首守护者与沿左侧滑落的蜿蜒长蛇
象征天地节律流转的同心圆环与八道放射轮辐
云端四角展翼展卷的四位圣兽使者——天使、苍鹰、圣牛与雄狮

en: Monumental gilded Art Nouveau celestial astrolabe wheel with eight gold filigree spokes and geometric diamond, crescent, and sunburst inlays
Jewel-blue gilded sphinx resting serenely atop the wheel summit holding a tiny vertical silver blade
Sunlit bronze jackal-headed guardian ascending the right rim opposite a sinuous vermilion-gold serpent gliding down the left edge
Four luminous winged celestial creatures—angel, eagle, winged bull, and winged lion—holding open blank illuminated folios in golden corner clouds
Swirling sapphire-cobalt and midnight-indigo cloudscape lit by a bright central golden halo
zh: 拥有八道古金花丝轮辐、镶嵌几何菱星与日月纹饰的宏伟新艺术星盘巨轮
安坐巨轮之巅、轻持细小银刃的宝石蓝鎏金斯芬克斯
沿轮右侧攀升的古铜胡狼首护卫与沿左侧盘旋而下的朱红金蛇
居于四角暖金云团中、捧着空白发光典籍的四尊展翼星界守护灵（天使、苍鹰、翼牛、翼狮）
中央暖金光晕烘托下的宝石蓝与午夜靛青翻涌云海

core.en: Wheel of Fortune marks an active turning of the tide: conditions outside your sole control are shifting, opening a timely window. Stay centered at the hub rather than clinging to the outer rim so you ride the turn well.
core.zh: 命运之轮标志时势正在真实转向：超出个人单方掌控的大周期开始转动，推开了一扇新的时机之窗。守住圆心的定力，而不死抓不断起伏的轮缘，就能顺势借到这股东风。

message.en: The season is shifting—stay agile, spot the emerging opening early, and adapt faster than stale habits expect.
message.zh: 风向已经变了——保持轻盈敏锐，第一时间接住正在浮现的契机，别拿上一季的旧惯性去套新周期。

foundation.en: An unexpected turn of timing, serendipitous encounter, or broader cycle shift set this entire chapter in motion.
foundation.zh: 一次意料之外的时机转折、机缘际会或大环境换挡，推开了眼下这段历程。

present.en: You are standing inside a live inflection point; small choices made at the pivot carry outsized downstream leverage.
present.zh: 你正身处真实的拐点之中；转折关头落下的每一小步，都会在后续产生远超平常的放大效应。

challenge.en: Beware banking on a lucky streak alone, or assuming today's upswing runs forever without stewardship.
challenge.zh: 别把好运当成永动机，也别以为眼下的顺风期无需妥善筹谋就会一直持续。

resource.en: Your strongest asset is adaptability and timing sense—reading momentum early instead of fighting a wave you can surf.
resource.zh: 你手中最强的筹码是应变弹性与节奏感——能提前读懂潮流走向，借浪前行而非迎头硬撞。

action.en: Say yes to the timely opening in front of you while building a simple buffer for the next inevitable turn of the cycle.
action.zh: 果断接住眼前出现的时机窗口，同时顺手为下一段周期波动预留一份稳妥缓冲。

outcome.en: A decisive shift is likely to break the stagnation: if you meet it, fresh momentum, serendipitous timing, or a long-awaited turn of luck tends to move the story onto a new arc.
outcome.zh: 一次清晰的转机很可能打破停滞：只要你接得住，新动量、恰逢其时的契机或久候的时运转暖，往往会带着局面进入新阶段。

advice.en: Anchor yourself at the quiet hub where the wheel stays still: move swiftly with change without tying your identity to any temporary high or low.
advice.zh: 把心安放于巨轮中心不动的轴心：行动上敏捷顺应变化，心态上却不把自我价值绑在任何一时起伏上。

hidden.en: A change may already be in motion that has not been announced or noticed yet. Look for early signs of the turn: a pattern repeating, a door opening quietly, a mood shifting around you.
hidden.zh: 一场变化也许已经在动了，只是还没人宣布，也还没被注意到。找找转向的早期迹象：某个规律又出现了，一扇门悄悄开了，周围的气氛在变。

self.en: You approach this as someone who accepts that things change and intends to move with them: alert to timing, ready to adjust, and not too attached to how it went last time.
self.zh: 你是抱着“事情总会变”的态度来的，也打算顺着变化走：对时机敏感，随时可以调整，对上一次是怎么过来的并不太执着。

other.en: The other party appears to be in the middle of a change of their own: circumstances shifting, plans in flux, luck turning. Their availability may depend more on timing than on intent.
other.zh: 对方看起来自己也正处在变动当中：处境在变，计划未定，运势在转。他们能不能配合，可能更多取决于时机，而不是意愿。

external.en: The wider situation is turning: markets, policies, or other people's decisions are shifting in ways you did not cause. Right now the movement opens a window, and windows of this kind do not stay open.
external.zh: 大局正在转向：行情、政策或别人的决定，都在以并非由你引起的方式变动。眼下这股变动推开了一扇窗，而这样的窗口不会一直开着。

hopes_fears.en: You hope this is finally your turn and that the timing is on your side, yet fear that what rises can drop again, and that you have less say in it than you would like.
hopes_fears.zh: 你希望这回终于轮到自己，时机也站在自己这边；又怕升上去的还会掉下来，而自己能说了算的部分，比期望的要少。

general.en: A meaningful turning point is underway. Stay nimble, honor good timing, and focus on what you can steer while letting larger cycles unfold.
general.zh: 一段意味深长的转折期正在展开。保持灵活身段、珍惜难得时机，抓稳自己能掌控的部分，其余交给大周期自然演进。

love.en: In love, Wheel of Fortune brings serendipitous meetings, refreshing chapter turns, or breaking out of repetitive relational loops. Welcome evolution together rather than freezing the past.
love.zh: 在感情中，命运之轮常带来奇妙缘分、关系换挡升温，或走出老套拉扯的新转机。与彼此共同拥抱成长，而非企图把关系定格在昨天。

career.en: At work, market cycles, org shifts, or fortunate timing create real openings. Position yourself visibly where momentum is rising and keep skills portable.
career.zh: 在事业上，行业周期、架构变动或恰到好处的风口正带来新机遇。尽早把自己的站位挪向势能上升处，并保持核心能力的可迁移性。

health.en: For wellbeing, notice seasonal, sleep, or energy cycles rather than expecting flat linear output every day—work with your natural peaks and recovery troughs.
health.zh: 在身心状态上，尊重季节、睡眠与精力的自然波峰波谷，别要求自己每天都像机器一样匀速满载——顺应节律调养反而更稳。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, impermanence is a teacher rather than a threat: every phase matures and yields, inviting deeper trust in the wider pattern.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，无常不是威胁而是导师：每个阶段都会盛放亦会谢幕，提醒你在更宏阔的节律中修得泰然定力。

core.en: Wheel of Fortune reversed points to friction with timing—clinging to a season that has already turned, feeling caught in a repeating pattern, or hitting unexpected external delays.
core.zh: 命运之轮逆位指向与时势节拍的错位——紧抓着早已过去的旧周期不肯松手、觉得陷入似曾相识的重复循环，或遭遇意料之外的外部延宕。

blocked.en: Resisting an inevitable shift creates far more friction than the change itself.
blocked.zh: 拼命抗拒早已不可逆转的变化，制造出的痛苦远大于变化本身。

excess.en: Gambling recklessly on luck or over-correcting wildly at every minor swing.
excess.zh: 把筹码盲目押在侥幸上，或随着每一次小波动剧烈折腾、自乱阵脚。

internalized.en: Feeling helplessly swept along by 'bad luck' while overlooking the one recurring habit keeping the loop spinning.
internalized.zh: 把一切归咎于运气不佳而感到无力，却忽略了自己手里那个不断重启旧循环的习惯。

release.en: Spotting the recurring pattern clearly enough to step off the old loop for good.
release.zh: 终于看清反复上演的旧剧本规律，彻底迈步走出那条兜圈子的老路。

message.en: This has happened before. Find the part of the pattern that repeats because of something you do, and change that instead of waiting for your luck to change.
message.zh: 这种情况以前就发生过。找出这个循环里因为你自己的做法才反复出现的那一环，去改它，而不是等着运气自己好转。

foundation.en: A cycle that should have ended was kept going: an old arrangement held onto after its time, or the same choice made again under a new name. That repetition is what you are standing on.
foundation.zh: 一个本该结束的循环被延续了下来：过了期的旧安排还抓着不放，或者同一个选择换了个名目又做了一遍。你现在脚下踩着的，就是这种重复。

present.en: Timing is against you for the moment: delays, reversals, plans that keep slipping. It feels like being carried around to the same spot again, with less control than you are used to.
present.zh: 眼下时机不在你这边：延误，变卦，计划一拖再拖。感觉像是又被转回了老地方，手里的掌控也比你习惯的少。

challenge.en: Bad timing, stubborn attachment to how things used to work, or a familiar repeating snag is slowing you down.
challenge.zh: 时机未熟、死守过往经验，或一再重演的熟悉卡点，正在拖慢你的脚步。

resource.en: You have been around this loop enough times to recognize its stages, and that familiarity is an advantage. A slow stretch also gives you time to shore up what you do control.
resource.zh: 这个圈你已经转过好几回，各个阶段都认得出来，这份熟悉就是优势。慢下来的这段时间，也让你有空把自己管得了的部分加固好。

action.en: Stop fighting the delay; map the repeating loop honestly, shore up what is under your control, and wait for the next clean window instead of forcing a bad bet.
action.zh: 先停止和延误硬较劲；如实画出这段反复出现的循环节点，扎紧自己能控的底盘，等下一个清晰窗口，别在逆风里强行豪赌。

outcome.en: A brief downturn or frustrating detour passes faster once you stop resisting it and update the habit that kept recreating it.
outcome.zh: 短暂的逆风或绕路只要不再硬杠、并改掉背后反复触发的旧惯性，很快便会柳暗花明。

advice.en: You cannot stop the wheel from turning, only choose how you stand while it moves—protect essentials and break one old automatic reaction.
advice.zh: 你拦不住巨轮转动，但能决定自己在转动时的站姿——护住基本盘，亲手打断一个老旧的条件反射。

hidden.en: Before blaming bad luck, check for the habit that keeps restarting the loop: a reaction, a kind of choice, a point where you always give way. It may be easier to see by asking what the last three setbacks had in common.
hidden.zh: 先别急着怪运气，找找是哪个习惯在反复重启这个循环：某种反应，某类选择，或者你总会让步的那个节点。问问最近三次挫折有什么共同点，也许更容易看出来。

self.en: You are meeting this as someone pushed around by events: braced for the next setback, attached to how things used to work, or tempted to bet big to get it all back at once.
self.zh: 你觉得自己在被事情推着走：提防着下一次挫折，放不下从前行得通的那一套，或者忍不住想押一把大的，一次全扳回来。

other.en: The other party may be caught in a downturn or delay of their own, and appears inconsistent as a result: keen one moment, unavailable the next. Their timing may simply not match yours right now.
other.zh: 对方可能自己也陷在低谷或延误里，因此显得反复无常：一会儿很积极，一会儿又找不到人。他们的节奏，眼下也许就是跟你的对不上。

external.en: The climate has turned unfavorable or unpredictable: a downturn, a policy change, decisions stalled elsewhere. None of it is aimed at you, and none of it is yours to hurry.
external.zh: 外部条件变得不利，或者难以预料：行情走低，政策调整，别处的决定卡着不动。这些都不是冲着你来的，也都不是你催得动的。

hopes_fears.en: You hope the run of bad timing is about to end. Underneath is the fear that it is not luck at all, and that the same thing will keep coming around until you change something you would rather keep.
hopes_fears.zh: 你希望这一连串不顺很快就到头；又怕这根本不是运气的问题，在你改掉某样不愿放手的东西之前，同样的事还会一再转回来。

general.en: External timing feels bumpy or repetitive right now. Let go of rigid scripts, avoid impulsive gambles, and change the one pattern you do control.
general.zh: 眼下外部节奏显得颠簸或似曾相识。放下死板剧本、避免意气用事的冒险，把精力集中到改写自己手里那条可控的旧模式上。

love.en: In love, reversed Wheel flags repeating the same argument or relationship script with a new face, or clinging past a natural transition. Break the familiar loop with one genuinely new response.
love.zh: 在感情中，命运之轮逆位提示旧争吵或相似的情感剧本反复重演，或不愿顺应关系的自然演进。用一个全新的真诚回应去打破老套循环。

career.en: At work, unexpected delays, shifting headwinds, or stubbornly defending an outdated playbook calls for calm contingency planning rather than panic pivots.
career.zh: 在职场上，突发延误、市场逆风或固守失效旧打法，都需要沉着预案与稳步迭代，而非慌乱折腾。

health.en: Recurring flare-ups or erratic rhythms hint at an unchanged trigger; track the cycle calmly and adjust one daily habit that keeps nudging balance off.
health.zh: 在身心层面，反复出现的疲倦或老毛病往往指向未被挪走的诱因；冷静记录节律，改掉那个一再打破平衡的日常习惯。

spirituality.en: Notice where fatalism ('nothing ever changes') excuses inaction—free will lives right inside how consciously you meet a repeating lesson.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，觉察宿命论（“反正改不了”）是否成了逃避改变的借口——自由意志就藏在你以全新觉知回应旧课题的那一念之间。

promptSpec.suitAccent: celestial burnished gold, rich sapphire-cobalt sky, terracotta-crimson, luminous ivory clouds, deep midnight-indigo corners
promptSpec.scene: Floating magnificently at the exact center of a swirling sapphire-and-midnight cloudscape is ONE monumental gilded Art Nouveau celestial astrolabe wheel with eight delicate gold filigree spokes and concentric amber-gold rings inlaid strictly with abstract geometric diamonds, tiny crescents, and sunburst medallions. Perched calmly atop the wheel's summit rests ONE jewel-blue gilded sphinx holding a tiny vertical silver blade; ascending the right outer rim climbs ONE sunlit bronze jackal-headed guardian; gliding downward along the left rim curls ONE sinuous vermilion-gold serpent, evoking eternal motion. Nestled cleanly inside four luminous golden-ivory corner clouds appear EXACTLY FOUR serene winged celestial creatures holding open blank illuminated folios—an angel at upper-left, an eagle at upper-right, a winged bull at lower-left, and a winged lion at lower-right. Radiant golden halo illumination separates the circular gilded wheel and four corner emblems sharply against deep velvety indigo shadows.

requiredObjects.object: central ornate gilded eight-spoked cosmic wheel
blue gilded sphinx perched atop wheel
rising bronze jackal figure on right rim
descending vermilion-gold serpent on left rim
winged celestial corner creatures in four corner clouds

promptSpec.compositionNote: Unmistakable bold golden circular wheel mandala anchored squarely at dead center, capped by the blue sphinx silhouette and framed evenly by four bright corner cloud emblems—reads effortlessly at 64x96 thumbnail size.

archetypeEssence.en: Clear-eyed accountability where choices, contracts, and consequences meet on level scales.
archetypeEssence.zh: 明察秋毫的公正与自省，让每一份选择、契约与后果在平稳天平上如实兑现。

en: Regal unblindfolded figure seated squarely facing forward between twin stone pillars
Straight double-edged sword held perfectly vertical in the right hand for clean discernment
Balanced golden scales suspended evenly from the left hand weighing truth without bias
Crimson robe beneath a green mantle and crown bearing a single square jewel
Draped royal veil stretched taut behind the throne separating clarity from noise
zh: 未蒙双眼、端坐于双石柱之间直视前方的庄重仲裁者
右手笔直竖握的双刃长剑，象征不偏不倚的裁断
左手平稳悬垂的金色天平，如实称量因果与公允
身披深红长袍与绿色披肩、冠冕正中镶嵌一方宝石的端方仪态
悬于宝座之后、隔绝外界干扰的挺括帷幕

en: Sovereign, unblindfolded Belle Epoque Justice seated frontally on a carved pale-stone throne between two symmetrical fluted pillars
Sculptural scarlet silk mantle lined in emerald-gold over an ivory tunic and gilded crown set with a single square gemstone
One straight, gleaming double-edged silver-and-gold sword held perfectly vertical in the right hand
One pair of perfectly level antique-gold balance scales suspended cleanly from the left hand against shadowed plum-crimson drapery
Crisp symmetrical twilight illumination highlighting calm eyes, gleaming vertical blade, and level golden pans
zh: 双目澄明、正面端坐于两根对称凹槽石柱之间雕石宝座上的美好年代正义女神
祖母绿金里衬的绯红丝绒披风、象牙白内袍与嵌有方形宝石的古金王冠
右手笔直竖握、刃面雪亮的一柄双刃银金长剑
左手稳提、在暗紫深红帷幕前清晰保持水平的一副古金天平
将冷静双眸、笔直长剑与均衡秤盘清晰勾勒出的对称微光

core.en: Justice deals in clean cause and effect, not luck or flattery. Look squarely at the verified facts, own your share of the ledger honestly, and expect fair outcomes proportional to what was actually put on the scales.
core.zh: 正义讲的是清清楚楚的因果对等，而不是侥幸或讨好。睁大眼睛核对事实、坦荡认领账本上属于自己的那一份，最终落下的结果也会与实际投入严丝合缝。

message.en: Strip out excuses and wishful spin—weigh the plain evidence fairly and make the decision you can stand behind in daylight.
message.zh: 剥掉借口与一厢情愿的润色——把实打实的证据放上天平，做出经得起阳光检验的裁决。

foundation.en: A past agreement, legal or formal commitment, or honest cause-and-effect chain directly produced today's state of play.
foundation.zh: 过往立下的协议、正式承诺，或环环相扣的真实因果，直接造就了今天的局面。

present.en: A formal review, contract, negotiation, or decisive truth check is underway; fairness and precision carry more weight than charm.
present.zh: 一场正式评估、条款核对、谈判或关键真相校验正在进行；此刻公允与严谨远比口才讨喜更有分量。

challenge.en: The difficulty here is the sting of strict accountability—owning an inconvenient consequence, or keeping clinical fairness from turning icy.
challenge.zh: 难处在于严格问责带来的刺痛——不得不认领某个不轻松的后果，或是得提防绝对理性变得不近人情。

resource.en: Your strongest asset is clean documentation and clear conscience—having the real facts, balanced terms, and honest intent on your side.
resource.zh: 你最硬的底牌是经得起查验的事实记录与坦荡立场——条款公道、证据扎实、动机清白，自然不惧审视。

action.en: Read every clause twice, put the true numbers on the table, and settle one lopsided obligation cleanly before moving on.
action.zh: 把每一条细则认真重读两遍，把真实数字摊上桌面，先把一笔失衡的旧账公正了结，再谈下一步。

outcome.en: If things keep being handled this honestly, the course tends toward a fair verdict or balanced resolution—one that rewards integrity and corrects tilted arrangements.
outcome.zh: 若继续这样坦荡处理，事情多半走向公道明朗的裁决或失衡归位——坦荡付出者有望得到对等回响，倾斜的安排也更可能被扶正。

advice.en: Keep both eyes wide open like the figure on the throne: fairness requires looking squarely at reality, not pretending bias doesn't exist.
advice.zh: 像宝座上未蒙双眼的仲裁者一样直视事实：真正的公正靠清醒审视，而不靠闭眼假装中立。

hidden.en: Check for a consequence already in motion that nobody has named yet—an old promise, an unread clause, or a debt of fairness you half remember. It may be weighing on this more than the visible arguments.
hidden.zh: 查一查有没有一桩后果已经在悄悄运转却没人点破：一句旧承诺、一条没细读的条款，或一笔你隐约记得的公道账。它对局面的分量，可能比台面上的争论更重。

self.en: You show up as the one who wants it done properly: facts checked, shares counted, your own part owned. That steadiness earns trust, though it can read as cool to people who wanted comfort first.
self.zh: 你在这件事里是那个坚持“按规矩办”的人：事实要核，份额要算，自己该担的也不躲。这份稳当让人信得过，只是想先被安慰的人，可能会觉得你有点冷。

other.en: The other party appears to be keeping careful score and may hold you to the letter of what was agreed. They are likely to respond to evidence and even-handed terms far more than to charm or pressure.
other.zh: 对方看起来账记得很细，很可能会按当初说好的条款逐字来对。比起套近乎或施压，摆事实、谈对等条件更容易得到他们的回应。

external.en: The setting around you runs on rules right now: a formal process, a deadline, a contract, or an authority that looks at records rather than intentions. Conditions favor whoever can show their work.
external.zh: 眼下的外部环境是按规则运转的：正式流程、截止日期、合同条款，或一个只看记录不看心意的评判方。谁能拿出清楚的凭据，局面就对谁有利。

hopes_fears.en: You hope the truth will finally be weighed fairly and your effort counted, yet fear what an honest tally might show about your own side of the scales.
hopes_fears.zh: 你盼着真相终于被公平称量、自己的付出被算进去，却又怕天平如实落下时，照出自己这一边也有亏欠。

general.en: Truth, accountability, and clean equilibrium take priority. Honor commitments accurately, check formal details, and let proportional fairness guide the verdict.
general.zh: 真相、担当与清晰平衡占据主导。严谨履行承诺、核清正式细则，让不偏不倚的公允指引最终决断。

love.en: In love, Justice calls for genuine mutuality—equal voice, honest repair after mistakes, and clear agreements about commitment rather than silent scorekeeping.
love.zh: 在感情中，正义呼唤真正的对等与真诚——平等话语权、犯错后的坦诚修补，以及清晰互守的约定，而非暗中算计计分。

career.en: At work, expect formal contracts, audits, performance reviews, legal approvals, or transparent merit evaluation. Keep records airtight and negotiate terms that are fair to both sides.
career.zh: 在事业上，常对应合同签署、审计评估、绩效定级、合规审批或靠硬实力说话的评审。保留完整书面凭证，谈出对双方都站得住脚的公道条款。

health.en: For wellbeing, bodily equilibrium mirrors daily inputs directly—sleep debt, workload, and nourishment show up honestly on the ledger, inviting steady rebalancing.
health.zh: 在身心层面，身体状态正像实诚的账本一样如实映照日常投入——熬夜透支、负荷与营养都会等价显形，提醒你及时调回平衡。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, integrity is alignment between inner truth and outward deed: drop self-deception and meet consequences with quiet dignity.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，正直就是内在良知与外在行为严丝合缝：放下自我辩解，坦然承接每个选择的回声。

core.en: Justice reversed signals tilted scales—dodging accountability, encountering unfair bias, or judging yourself and others through distorted lenses rather than plain evidence.
core.zh: 正义逆位提示天平失衡——要么有人在回避应负之责、局面存在显失公允的偏倚，要么你正带着扭曲滤镜严苛评判自己或他人。

blocked.en: Delaying a necessary ruling, paperwork review, or honest admission keeps an unfair stalemate alive.
blocked.zh: 拖着该做的裁断、条款核查或坦白认错不处理，让本不公道的僵局继续发酵。

excess.en: Self-righteous rigidity—weaponizing technical rules to punish instead of seeking true fairness.
excess.zh: 自以为是的苛刻较真——拿条款细则当武器去惩罚别人，却丢掉了公允本意。

internalized.en: Holding yourself to an impossibly punitive verdict while excusing everyone else's mistakes.
internalized.zh: 对旁人处处宽容，却在心里对自己下达毫不留情的苛刻判词。

release.en: Refusing to play rigged games—stepping back from a skewed deal and restoring clean personal standards.
release.zh: 拒绝再陪失衡的局耗下去——撤出显失公平的约定，重新立稳自己的干净准则。

message.en: Something here is not being weighed evenly. Before you argue the result, find where the scale is tilted—a missing fact, a double standard, or a verdict on yourself you would never hand to a friend.
message.zh: 这件事里有东西没被公平称量。先别急着争结果，找出天平歪在哪里：缺了一块事实、用了双重标准，还是给自己下了一个你绝不会判给朋友的重判。

foundation.en: An earlier unfair call, a dodged admission, or terms nobody read closely left the account unsettled. The present friction grows from that unbalanced starting point.
foundation.zh: 早先一次不公的裁断、一句躲过去的认错，或一份谁都没细看的条款，让这笔账一直没结清。如今的摩擦，正是从那个失衡的起点长出来的。

present.en: Things are lopsided right now: one side carries more blame or cost than the facts support, and a decision or honest admission keeps getting put off.
present.zh: 眼下的局面明显偏了：有一方背着超出事实的指责或代价，而该做的决定、该说的那句实话，一直被往后推。

challenge.en: Bias, evasiveness, messy fine print, or reluctance to own a mistake is warping the outcome.
challenge.zh: 偏见、推诿、含糊条款或不肯认领失误，正在把事情引向失真走向。

resource.en: You can still tell when a deal is skewed, and that instinct is worth trusting. Walking away from a rigged game costs less than winning it, and your own standards remain yours to restore.
resource.zh: 你依然分辨得出哪笔约定是歪的，这份直觉值得相信。从一场不公平的局里退出，代价比硬赢下来要小；而你自己的准则，随时可以重新立起来。

action.en: Verify every missing fact independently, name the imbalance plainly on the record, and own any blind spot that belongs to you.
action.zh: 独立复核每一处被略过的事实，把不公之处清楚落到记录里，同时也干脆认领属于自己的那部分盲区。

outcome.en: Left unaddressed, bias or sloppy contracts are likely to linger as friction; refusing shortcuts and insisting on documented fairness gives the ledger its best chance of righting itself.
outcome.zh: 被敷衍过去的偏颇与漏洞多半会留下后患；拒绝走捷径、坚持书面公允，账本才最有机会逐步归平。

advice.en: Do not sign under pressure or hide behind excuses—seek neutral second eyes whenever emotions tilt the scales.
advice.zh: 切忌在催促下仓促落笔，也别拿借口替自己遮掩——当情绪让天平倾斜时，主动引入冷静中立的第三方视角。

hidden.en: Ask whether a quiet bias is steering this: a rule applied to one person but not another, or a private sentence you passed on yourself long ago. It is worth testing before you trust the verdict.
hidden.zh: 问一问是否有不易察觉的偏心在左右局面：同一条规矩只对某个人较真，或是你很久以前就在心里给自己定了罪。在相信结论之前，值得先验一验。

self.en: You may be arriving as judge and accused at once—strict to the letter with others, or merciless with yourself. Either way, the measuring stick you are holding is bent.
self.zh: 你可能同时扮演着法官和被告：要么对别人抠着条文不放，要么对自己毫不留情。无论哪一种，你手里那把尺子本身已经弯了。

other.en: The other party may be sidestepping their share, leaning on technicalities, or working from a one-sided account. Treat that as a pattern to verify in their actions, not a motive you can prove.
other.zh: 对方可能在回避自己该担的那一份、抠字眼做文章，或只按一面之词理解经过。把这当成需要从行动中核实的迹象，而不是已经坐实的动机。

external.en: The process around you is not level right now: unclear rules, a stalled decision, or a referee with a stake in the result. Fair treatment is not something this setting hands out by default.
external.zh: 眼下外部的程序并不平整：规则含糊、决定迟迟不下，或裁判自己也牵涉其中。在这样的环境里，公道不会自动送到你手上。

hopes_fears.en: You hope someone will finally admit what was unfair and set it right, yet fear that pressing the point will expose your own part, or prove that nobody plans to balance it at all.
hopes_fears.zh: 你希望终于有人承认哪里不公并把它扶正，却又怕追究下去会牵出自己的那一份，或发现根本没人打算把账算平。

general.en: Look closely for lopsided terms, rationalizations, or unfair judgment. Correct blind spots calmly and insist on verified facts before committing.
general.zh: 仔细排查不对等的条件、自我合理化的借口或带偏见的定论。冷静修正盲点，没核清真实证据前绝不草率拍板。

love.en: In love, reversed Justice flags uneven emotional labor, keeping resentful score, or dodging blame during conflict. Stop arguing over who is 'right' and repair actual fairness.
love.zh: 在感情中，正义逆位暴露付出失衡、翻旧账计分或在冲突中互相甩锅。停下争辩谁占理，把真正公平的相处方式修补回来。

career.en: At work, double-check contracts, credit attribution, office politics, and compliance details. Protect yourself with clear written trails rather than informal handshakes.
career.zh: 在职场上，务必反复审阅合同条款、功劳归属、团队偏倚与合规细节。用清晰可查的书面凭证护住自己，别轻信口头承诺。

health.en: Imbalanced routines or brushing off a warning sign catches up quietly; be candid with yourself about what habit is tipping the scale off center.
health.zh: 在身心层面，失衡的作息或一再敷衍的轻微不适正在暗中记账；诚实面对究竟是哪个习惯把天平压偏了。

spirituality.en: Lay down both harsh self-condemnation and subtle victimhood; honest accountability frees far more energy than guilt ever could.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，同时放下苛刻自责与隐性受害者心态；清醒坦荡的负责，比沉浸在愧疚里释放出多得多的自由。

promptSpec.suitAccent: sovereign scarlet-crimson, crisp frost-silver steel, burnished antique gold, moonlit ivory, deep midnight-indigo shadows
promptSpec.scene: Facing squarely forward with calm, unblindfolded, lucid eyes, ONE regal Belle Epoque figure of Justice sits upright upon a carved pale-stone throne flanked cleanly by TWO symmetrical fluted temple pillars and a richly draped royal-plum and scarlet curtain. Dressed in a sculptural scarlet silk mantle lined with emerald-gold over an ivory tunic and wearing a burnished gold crown set with a single square gemstone, Justice holds EXACTLY ONE long, straight, gleaming double-edged silver-and-gold sword perfectly vertical in the right hand. Suspended from the outstretched left hand hangs EXACTLY ONE pair of gleaming, perfectly level antique-gold balance scales silhouetted clearly against the dark shadowed archway so both pans read distinctly. Crisp symmetrical illumination spotlights the serene unblindfolded face, vertical silver blade, and balanced golden scales for unmistakable axial clarity.

requiredObjects.object: seated unblindfolded figure of Justice
vertical upright double-edged silver-gold sword in right hand
perfectly level antique-gold balance scales in left hand
symmetrical fluted sanctuary pillars

promptSpec.compositionNote: Razor-clean frontal bilateral symmetry: scarlet-robed seated sovereign flanked by bright vertical silver blade on one side and glowing level gold scales on the other—instantly distinguishable even at 64x96 thumbnail.

archetypeEssence.en: Voluntary suspension and inverted perspective—loosening frantic grip so a hidden insight can dawn.
archetypeEssence.zh: 主动悬停与倒转视角——松开焦躁硬推的手，让顺势看不见的深层洞见悄然照亮。

en: Calm figure suspended upside down by one ankle from a living T-shaped timber crossbeam
Fresh green leaves sprouting directly from the wooden beam as quiet ongoing life
Opposite leg tucked effortlessly behind the knee in a balanced figure-four pose
Hands relaxed calmly behind the back showing willing surrender rather than struggle
Luminous golden halo blazing brightly around the inverted head
zh: 以单踝倒悬于T形活木横梁之上、神情安然的旅人
自木梁枝节间抽出的鲜嫩绿叶，象征停顿中的生机未断
另一条腿从容曲折成数字四字形的自在姿态
双手安稳收于身后，流露自愿沉淀而非挣扎受困
环绕在倒垂头颅四周、灿烂生辉的金色光环

en: Serene Belle Epoque traveler suspended peacefully upside down by a neat golden cord from a living T-shaped oak crossbeam sprouting tender emerald leaves
Graceful figure-four leg posture with hands relaxed calmly behind the back in luminous cerulean-blue tunic and crimson leggings
Radiant filigree-rayed molten-gold halo blazing warmly around the upside-down head and tranquil smiling face
Vast starry midnight-indigo negative space framing the iconic inverted silhouette with effortless stillness
Warm ivory-gold halo light rising subtly up the traveler's shoulders against deep twilight shadow
zh: 以纤细金绳系于单踝、安然倒悬在抽出嫩绿新叶的T形活木横梁上的美好年代旅人
双腿自然交叠成四字形、双手轻背身后，身着天蓝绣袍与绯红长袜的舒展剪影
在倒垂头颅与安详笑颜四周灿然绽放的熔金射线光环
将标志性倒悬轮廓清晰托出的辽阔星辰午夜蓝留白
自下方金环向上轻拂衣领与双肩的温润象牙金微光

core.en: The Hanged Man turns a pause into a vantage point: pushing harder right now only jams the lock. Step willingly out of urgency, look at the whole situation upside down, and trade a small short-term sacrifice for unmistakable clarity.
core.zh: 倒吊人把看似停滞的空窗转化为难得的观测位：此刻越用力硬推越容易卡死锁芯。主动从急迫感里抽身、倒转角度重看全盘，用一次有意识的小妥协换回彻底清醒的洞见。

message.en: Stop forcing movement for a beat—suspend your usual assumptions and examine this problem from the opposite angle.
message.zh: 先停下强推节奏的动作——把习以为常的前提暂时悬置，彻底站到反面视角重看这件事。

foundation.en: A deliberate pause, unexpected delay, or conscious sacrifice changed how you see what actually matters.
foundation.zh: 一次主动按下的暂停、始料未及的延宕或甘愿做出的取舍，悄然改写了你对轻重缓急的判断。

present.en: Outward progress feels slow or suspended, yet genuine internal reframing is doing quiet heavy lifting beneath the surface.
present.zh: 表面进度看似悬在半空，实则深层的观念重构正在水面下安静发力，做着真正吃重的功课。

challenge.en: Limbo itself is the hard part—staying calm while the answers are not yet ready to drop into your lap, and resisting the urge to pry them loose early.
challenge.zh: 难熬的正是这份悬而未决——答案尚未成熟落地时，既要稳住心神，又要克制住急于硬撬的冲动。

resource.en: Your strongest asset is patience and lateral sight—seeing a fresh exit everyone rushing at normal speed walks straight past.
resource.zh: 你手中最强的资源是沉得住气的逆向视野——能看清那些一路狂奔的人擦肩而过的隐藏出口。

action.en: Release one tactic that clearly isn't working, let the timeline breathe, and test the exact counter-intuitive view you dismissed earlier.
action.zh: 干脆松开那套已经证明行不通的旧打法，给时间表留出呼吸余地，去认真检验你此前一眼否掉的逆向思路。

outcome.en: If you let the pause do its work, a shift in perspective is likely to dissolve a stubborn knot, and movement tends to resume on far wiser terms than haste would have bought.
outcome.zh: 若肯让这段停顿发挥作用，视角的翻转很可能解开那个死结；之后重启推进时，局面往往比仓促行动高明得多。

advice.en: Willing surrender is not defeat—notice the bright halo shines precisely because the traveler stopped thrashing against the rope.
advice.zh: 清醒的放手绝非认输——正因为旅人不再跟绳索徒劳撕扯，头顶那圈洞见之光才得以明亮燃起。

hidden.en: Look for the view you have been refusing to take. A belief you treat as fixed—what must happen first, or who has to move—may be the knot itself, and it has not been questioned yet.
hidden.zh: 找一找那个你一直不肯站过去看的角度。某个被你当成铁律的前提——哪件事必须先发生，该由谁先动——可能正是死结本身，只是还没被质疑过。

self.en: You are the one willing to wait while others push, holding still long enough to see differently. You bring patience and a readiness to give something up for a clearer answer.
self.zh: 别人都在往前挤的时候，你是那个愿意停下来等的人，停得够久，才看得出不一样的东西。你带来的是耐心，以及肯拿一点舍弃去换清醒答案的气度。

other.en: They appear to be in no hurry and may be holding back a decision while they rethink things. Their stillness looks more like reflection than rejection, so pressing for an answer may only lengthen the wait.
other.zh: 对方看上去并不着急，可能正按着决定不表态，好把事情重新想一遍。这种不动更像是在沉淀而不是拒绝，催着要答复，多半只会让等待更久。

external.en: Circumstances have put things on hold: a queue, a review period, someone else's timetable. Nothing outside is broken; the timing simply does not respond to effort for now.
external.zh: 外部条件把事情按下了暂停键：排队、审核期，或别人手里的时间表。外面并没有哪里坏了，只是这段时间，使劲也换不来进度。

hopes_fears.en: Part of you hopes this pause is leading to an insight that changes everything; another part fears you are merely stuck, giving up time and ground while everyone else moves on.
hopes_fears.zh: 你心里一半盼着这段停顿能等来一个改变全局的领悟，另一半却怕自己只是卡住了，白白让出时间和位置，眼看别人一个个走远。

general.en: A constructive pause invites fresh eyes. Release brittle urgency, accept a temporary delay gracefully, and look for the overlooked angle.
general.zh: 这是一段富有价值的悬停期。松开焦躁执念，从容接住暂时的放缓，在反常规的角度里找到真正突破口。

love.en: In love, The Hanged Man asks you to pause automatic reactions and truly see through the other person's lens—or give a relationship breathing room to clarify without pressure.
love.zh: 在感情中，倒吊人提醒先按住习惯性情绪反应，真正换位体察对方眼中的世界——或给关系留出不施压的缓冲空间，让真心自然沉淀。

career.en: At work, a stalled approval, sabbatical, or strategic rethink is actually protecting you from building down the wrong corridor. Reframe the problem before doubling headcount or budget.
career.zh: 在事业上，暂缓的审批、间隔沉淀或战略重审其实是在帮你避开走偏的死胡同。先重构问题定义，别急着继续加码投入。

health.en: For wellbeing, forced rest or intentional slowdown carries a clear message: listen to recovery limits now rather than bargaining with exhaustion.
health.zh: 在身心调理上，主动放慢或被迫休整都带着清晰讯号：顺从身体的恢复节律，别再拿疲惫去硬换进度。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, letting go of ego control opens direct illumination: clarity arrives when you stop insisting reality match your old script.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，松开小我的执控才会迎来真正的开悟：当你不再要求世界照你的旧剧本演，清明的洞见自然降临。

core.en: The Hanged Man reversed exposes fruitless limbo—either stalling in martyr-like inaction long after the lesson is clear, or thrashing impatiently against a necessary pause.
core.zh: 倒吊人逆位揭示出空耗的僵持——要么早已看明白却沉溺于被动忍耐与自我牺牲迟迟不落脚，要么死活不肯接受必要缓冲、在原地焦躁挣扎。

blocked.en: Dragging out indecision under the excuse of 'waiting for clarity' when you already know the answer.
blocked.zh: 心里其实早有答案，却拿“再等等看清一点”当借口，把必要决定一拖再拖。

excess.en: Needless self-sacrifice or playing the noble martyr while quietly expecting someone else to rescue you.
excess.zh: 无谓的自我牺牲与苦情隐忍，暗中指望旁人看懂你的委屈来替你破局。

internalized.en: Restless resentment simmering underneath passive waiting.
internalized.zh: 表面一动不动地等着，内心却满是不甘与焦灼的内耗。

release.en: Cutting the cord cleanly—ending a stagnant delay and stepping back onto solid ground with your new insight.
release.zh: 干脆利落地解绳落地——结束毫无意义的空等，带着已经想通的洞见重新迈步。

message.en: The waiting has done its work: if you already know the answer, more hanging adds nothing, and if the delay is real, fighting it only tires you out. Decide which one this is.
message.zh: 这段等待该教的已经教完了：如果你心里早有答案，再吊着也不会多出什么；如果延迟是真的，硬扛只会把自己累垮。先分清眼下是哪一种。

foundation.en: A pause that once made sense went on too long, or a sacrifice was made that nobody asked for. Much of the current stuckness traces back to that overstayed wait.
foundation.zh: 一段原本合理的停顿被拖得太久，或是做了一次其实没人要求的牺牲。眼下的卡顿，很大一部分要追溯到那场等过了头的等待。

present.en: You are in a limbo that has stopped teaching you anything—outwardly waiting, inwardly restless, with the decision postponed under the label of needing more clarity.
present.zh: 你正悬在一段已经学不到新东西的空档里：表面在等，心里发躁，而那个决定被贴上“还要再看清一点”的标签，一再往后放。

challenge.en: Pointless stalling, passive martyrdom, or fighting an unavoidable wait is draining energy without adding wisdom.
challenge.zh: 毫无产出的拖延、自我感动的退让，或跟不可避免的等待硬顶，都在白白消耗心气。

resource.en: The insight is already earned; the hanging bought it. What remains usable is that changed view, plus the plain relief of putting your feet down and no longer paying for a stalemate.
resource.zh: 那份领悟已经到手了，是这段悬着的日子换来的。眼下还能用的，正是这个变过的视角，以及双脚落地、不再为僵局买单的那份轻松。

action.en: End the stalemate today: stop making unnecessary sacrifices for a stuck situation and take one grounded step back onto your own feet.
action.zh: 今天就打破悬空状态：停止为停滞的局面继续做无谓牺牲，稳稳踏回实地，迈出属于自己的第一步。

outcome.en: This limbo is likely to drag on only as long as you keep stalling or struggling against the clock; drop either habit and real forward motion tends to return.
outcome.zh: 只要还在空等或瞎急，这段悬置期多半就会拖下去；放下其中任何一种惯性，实在的推进感往往就能重新接通。

advice.en: A pause stops being wise the moment it turns into avoidance; take the insight you already earned and move.
advice.zh: 一旦停顿滑向逃避，它就不再是智慧；拿好你早已悟出的那点清醒，果断落地行动。

hidden.en: Consider whether the patience hides a hope of rescue: giving things up so that someone notices and acts for you. If resentment is building under the calm, that is worth admitting.
hidden.zh: 想一想这份耐心底下是否藏着被拯救的期待：一次次退让，是盼着有人看见、替你出手。如果平静底下正攒着怨气，那就值得承认。
