Low warm stone garden wall separating tidy shelter from open sunlit play
Four tall golden sunflowers turning boldly outward in abundant bloom
zh: 悬于高空、神情祥和并放射直曲相间万丈金芒的璀璨太阳
张开双臂、自在骑乘洁白骏马的欢快孩童
在晴空微风中猎猎飘扬的绯红丝绸长旗
围护花园的低矮暖石矮墙，象征安稳与敞开
越过石墙饱满盛放、热烈朝向观者的四株金色向日葵

en: Gigantic Klimt-inspired burnished antique-gold sun medallion with serene smiling visage and alternating straight and wavy rays filling the upper sky
Radiant Belle Epoque child in a light ivory tunic and floral wreath riding effortlessly astride a prancing pearl-white horse
Long billowing scarlet-vermilion silk banner lifted dynamically overhead across sunlit gold sky
Low carved limestone garden wall topped by exactly four vibrant blooming golden sunflowers facing cleanly outward
High-key molten saffron-gold and pearl-ivory illumination accented along the upper rim by deep celestial twilight indigo
zh: 占据上空、带有克里姆特鎏金质感与祥和笑颜、直曲光线交错的辉煌太阳圆轮
身着月白小衫、头戴花环、神采飞扬骑乘珠白骏马的美好年代孩童
在灿烂金光中随风舒展飘扬的炽烈绯红丝绸长幡
雕花浅石矮墙后清晰盛放、迎光舒展的四朵硕大金色向日葵
由熔金、藏红花暖光与珠白高光铺就、天际微镶靛蓝星边的朗润华彩

core.en: The Sun brings unmistakable clarity, warmth, and open-hearted success. Nothing vital needs to stay hidden in corners right now—step into full visibility, celebrate real wins generously, and let straightforward joy fuel your next chapter.
core.zh: 太阳带来毫无遮掩的清晰、暖意与坦荡成就。此刻没有必要躲在阴影里试探或缩手缩脚——大方走入阳光、真诚庆贺实在成果，让纯粹敞亮的喜悦推动下一程。

message.en: Choose simplicity, candor, and full daylight—what is true and good here shines brighter the more openly you express it.
message.zh: 选择坦率、明朗与毫无保留——眼下真正美好且扎实的事，越是大方亮出来越能大放异彩。

foundation.en: Warm support, genuine optimism, or an unambiguous past breakthrough laid bright, healthy footing underneath you.
foundation.zh: 过往真挚的善意支持、坦荡心态或一次亮堂突破，为你铺好了健康明朗的底色。

present.en: Clarity, vitality, and positive visibility peak right now; doubts dissolve quickly when brought into direct conversation.
present.zh: 清晰度、生命力与外在能见度正处高点；原本犹豫的疑惑，只要摊到明面上说清便会迎刃而解。

challenge.en: Easy confidence can glare: basking in it so brightly that you skim past fine details, or hog the spotlight without meaning to, is the risk to watch.
challenge.zh: 顺风顺水的自信也会晃眼：要提防因光环正盛而略过细微隐患，或在无意间占满了全部聚光灯。

resource.en: Your strongest asset is radiant authenticity—warmth, optimism, and direct honesty that lift morale across the whole room.
resource.zh: 你最强的优势是坦荡感染力——发自内心的热情、爽朗与坦诚，能自然照亮并带动整个场域的士气。

action.en: Put your work, feelings, or gratitude into open view today—publish, celebrate visibly, and share credit warmly with those beside you.
action.zh: 今天就大方把作品、心意或谢意亮在日光之下——发布成果、真诚庆祝，并把荣光温暖分给并肩同行的人。

outcome.en: Things are heading toward bright clarity, earned recognition, and heartfelt joy; if you stay this open, lingering uncertainty is likely to give way to a warm resolution.
outcome.zh: 事情正朝着明朗的结果、实至名归的认可与由衷的欢欣发展；保持这份坦荡，此前悬着的不确定很可能化为温暖的圆满。

advice.en: Stop shrinking to make others comfortable; shine cleanly, share warmth generously, and enjoy what you actually built.
advice.zh: 别再为了迁就气氛而刻意收起光芒；坦然发亮、慷慨传递暖意，好好享受你亲手创造的成果。

hidden.en: Very little is concealed here, and that itself may be what you have not accepted. Check whether you are searching for a catch because plain good news is harder to trust than trouble.
hidden.zh: 这件事里几乎没有什么藏着的，而这一点本身，可能恰恰是你还没接受的。看一看你是不是正在找破绽，只因为单纯的好消息比麻烦更难让人相信。

self.en: You show up warm, direct, and easy to read, with nothing to hide and real energy to give. People know where they stand with you, and that confidence is a large part of what you bring.
self.zh: 你带着暖意出现，直来直去，让人一眼就看得明白：没有什么要藏的，还有实打实的精力可以给。和你相处，谁都知道自己的位置，这份底气正是你带来的一大部分。

other.en: The other person appears open and glad to be involved, and is likely to say what they mean. Their warmth looks straightforward, so take it at face value unless their actions give you a reason not to.
other.zh: 对方看起来很敞开，也乐于参与，多半是有话直说的人。他们的热情看上去并不绕弯，除非行动上出现反例，否则照字面理解就好。

external.en: The climate is favorable: visible support, good timing, people in a generous mood. Outside conditions are clear and warm, and little is working against you from that side.
external.zh: 外部气候是有利的：看得见的支持、合适的时机、周围人大方的心情。外在条件晴朗而温暖，从这一侧来的阻力很少。

hopes_fears.en: You hope for simple, visible happiness, the kind you can show without apology, yet fear being fully seen, or that once things are this good they have nowhere to go but down.
hopes_fears.zh: 你盼着一种简单、看得见的快乐，可以不带歉意地亮出来，却又怕被人完全看见，也怕好到这个份上，接下来只剩走下坡路。

general.en: Clarity, vitality, and honest fulfillment illuminate everything you touch. Act transparently, share warmth, and welcome earned good fortune with grace.
general.zh: 清明、活力与踏实喜悦正照亮你手头的一切。光明磊落地行动，大方分享暖意，从容接住应得的好局面。

love.en: In love, The Sun radiates playful warmth, unguarded affection, and transparent trust—joyful togetherness, open communication, and mutual pride in who you are together.
love.zh: 在感情中，太阳散发炽烈温情、毫无猜忌的敞亮信赖与像孩子般自在的愉悦——彼此坦诚相待，由衷为这段并肩同行感到骄傲。

career.en: At work, expect visible breakthroughs, strong launches, clear recognition, and energizing teamwork. Step forward visibly and present your best work without downplaying its impact.
career.zh: 在事业上，预示高光突破、亮眼发布、实质嘉奖与昂扬协作。大方站到台前展示过硬作品，不必过分谦抑自己的贡献。

health.en: For wellbeing, vibrant energy, sunlight, outdoor movement, and genuine laughter replenish stamina—soak in restorative warmth while staying hydrated and well paced.
health.zh: 在身心状态上，充沛元气、自然日光、户外舒展与发自肺腑的轻松欢笑最能滋养生命力——尽情拥抱明朗活力，同时保持补水与合理节律。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, enlightenment is not austere detachment—it is unclouded presence, childlike gratitude, and wholehearted delight in ordinary light.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，觉悟从非枯槁疏离——而是清澈坦荡的临在、赤子般的感恩，以及对平凡日常之光的由衷欢喜。

core.en: The Sun reversed is sunlight filtered through passing haze—warmth and potential remain intact, yet temporary fatigue, dimmed confidence, or overblown ego is clouding full enjoyment.
core.zh: 太阳逆位好比穿过薄云的晴光——底层的暖意与好局并未消失，但暂时的疲惫、一时黯淡的自信，或浮夸好胜正在遮暗本该纯粹的喜悦。

blocked.en: Good results feel muted because burnout or perfectionism won't let you actually savor them.
blocked.zh: 成果其实已经不错，却因疲惫或挑剔完美主义，迟迟无法真正高兴起来。

excess.en: Performative optimism, chasing spotlight validation, or sun-blind overconfidence ignoring real limits.
excess.zh: 刻意硬挤出的乐观、贪恋聚光灯掌声，或盲目自信忽略了脚下真实边界。

internalized.en: Quiet private warmth that you hesitate to share aloud for fear of jinxing or standing out.
internalized.zh: 心里其实藏着笃定的亮光，却怕太招眼或好景不长而不敢大方展露。

release.en: Letting go of forced cheer and spotlight pressure so simple, authentic contentment can return.
release.zh: 卸下必须时刻高光耀眼的包袱，让朴素真实的开心重新回流。

message.en: The good is still here, only quieter than you expected. Stop performing brightness and let yourself enjoy what is actually going well, at its real size.
message.zh: 好的东西还在，只是比你预想的安静。别再表演光芒万丈，按它真实的大小，去享受确实进展顺利的那部分。

foundation.en: A success that felt flat, praise that came late, or a season of keeping up a cheerful front has shaped this. Somewhere back there, enjoying things became conditional on their being perfect.
foundation.zh: 一次没尝出滋味的成功、一份迟到的肯定，或一段硬撑着笑脸的日子，造成了现在的样子。就在那时，“高兴”变成了一件必须先完美才被允许的事。

present.en: Things are basically fine and you are not quite feeling it: tired, a little flat, or busy looking happier than you are. The warmth is filtered at the moment, not lost.
present.zh: 事情基本顺利，你却没怎么感觉到：有些累，有点提不起劲，或者正忙着显得比实际更开心。眼下的暖意只是被滤掉了一层，并没有丢。

challenge.en: Temporary delays, dim self-belief, or trying too hard to look effortlessly sunny is stealing real joy.
challenge.zh: 阶段性的延迟、信心略显不足，或用力维持“一切很好”的体面，正在悄悄偷走真快乐。

resource.en: Underneath the tiredness the basics are sound: real ability, real goodwill, results that exist whether or not they were applauded. A smaller, private gladness is available now, and it asks nothing of you.
resource.zh: 疲惫底下，底子是好的：真实的能力、真实的善意，还有无论有没有掌声都已经存在的成果。一份更小、更私人的高兴现在就能拿到，而且它不向你要求任何东西。

action.en: Drop toxic positivity and spotlight chasing; acknowledge one genuine win already on the board and check one overlooked practical detail.
action.zh: 放下硬撑乐观与虚荣较劲；认真肯定桌上已有的那份实在成绩，再把一个容易忽略的现实细节补牢。

outcome.en: Success is still likely, though it tends to come quieter or slightly later than imagined—and grounded pride outlasts flashy applause.
outcome.zh: 好结果仍然可期，只是多半比预想的稍晚一步或更低调朴实——扎实的踏实感远比喧闹的喝彩持久。

advice.en: You do not have to blaze at noon every day; steady morning warmth is plenty to keep growing.
advice.zh: 不必每天都像正午烈日一样耀眼；清朗平稳的晨光，早已足够万物生长。

hidden.en: Ask whether the cheerfulness is covering fatigue, or whether confidence has drifted into ignoring a limit. It is also worth checking for a quiet happiness you are keeping to yourself in case it does not last.
hidden.zh: 问一问这份开朗是不是在盖着疲惫，或者自信是否已经滑向了对某个限度的视而不见。也值得看一看，有没有一份你怕它不长久而藏着没说的小欢喜。

self.en: You are putting on a brighter face than you feel, or leaning on confidence to avoid a small doubt. The ability is real; the need to look effortless is the part that wears you down.
self.zh: 你正摆出一副比真实感受更明亮的表情，或者靠着自信绕开一点小小的疑虑。能力是真的，“必须显得毫不费力”这一条，才是把你磨累的部分。

other.en: They may be overselling how well things are going, or appear upbeat while running on empty. Enthusiasm from their side is probably sincere but inflated, so wait for results before you match it.
other.zh: 对方可能把情况说得比实际更好，或者看上去兴致很高，其实已经在硬撑。他们的热情大概是真心的，只是有些虚高，不妨等看到结果，再跟着兴奋。

external.en: Outside conditions are good but hazy: recognition delayed, a celebration postponed, an upbeat mood that glosses over details. The setting is friendly, though slower and less clear than it looks.
external.zh: 外部条件不差，只是蒙着一层薄雾：认可来得晚，庆祝被推迟，一片乐观的气氛盖过了细节。环境是友好的，只是比看上去更慢，也没那么清楚。

hopes_fears.en: You hope to feel as happy as the situation says you should, yet fear that the glow is an act, or that sharing your gladness openly will tempt it to fade.
hopes_fears.zh: 你希望自己能像局面“应该”的那样开心，却又怕这层光亮只是演出来的，或者一旦把高兴说出口，它就会跟着淡掉。

general.en: Passing clouds are not permanent night. Ease off grand expectations, verify small blind spots, and rediscover quiet everyday enjoyment.
general.zh: 薄云掠过绝非长夜降临。调低不切实际的完美预期、补查细微盲点，重新拾起平凡日子里真切的明快感。

love.en: In love, reversed Sun flags minor ego friction, taking shared warmth for granted, or forcing cheer instead of naming a tender gripe. Small sincere appreciation restores ease fast.
love.zh: 在感情中，太阳逆位提示轻微的自尊较劲、把彼此的温暖习以为常，或强装没事掩盖小委屈。几句真诚肯定与坦率沟通很快便能拨云见日。

career.en: At work, delayed recognition, overextended enthusiasm, or polished optics masking messy execution need steady calibration. Focus on real quality over quick applause.
career.zh: 在职场上，嘉奖稍有延迟、热情透支或表面光鲜却细节松散都需要及时微调。把重心放回过硬质量，而不急着博取掌声。

health.en: Mild burnout or overexertion dims natural bounce; step back from pushing through sunny days on empty and reclaim simple daylight rest.
health.zh: 在身心层面，轻度耗竭或过度透支正压低原本的活力；别再空着电量硬撑活跃，补回朴素充足的日光与休整。

spirituality.en: Beware spiritual pride or chasing constant bliss—authentic brightness includes humble, quiet days too.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，警惕隐性优越感或执着于时刻喜悦——真正的明亮同样坦然接纳平淡安静的日子。

promptSpec.suitAccent: blazing sunlit molten gold, warm saffron-amber, crisp scarlet-vermilion silk, luminous pearl-ivory, rich twilight-indigo edge accents
promptSpec.scene: Filling the luminous upper sky with opulent Klimt-inspired brilliance blazes ONE gigantic burnished antique-gold sun medallion featuring a serene, warmly smiling celestial face and alternating straight and undulating gilded rays radiating across sunlit ivory-gold sky trimmed softly at the upper corners with deep celestial indigo. In the bright golden foreground rides ONE radiant, joyful Belle Epoque child wearing a light ivory tunic and delicate floral wreath, seated bareback with open arms atop ONE prancing luminous pearl-white horse while flying ONE long, billowing scarlet-vermilion silk banner streaming dynamically across the breeze. Directly behind the white horse runs a low carved pale-limestone garden wall crested cleanly by EXACTLY FOUR large, vibrant blooming golden sunflowers turned boldly outward toward the viewer. Warm high-key golden-ivory illumination makes the giant radiant sun, jubilant child, white horse, scarlet banner, and four bright sunflowers glow with unforgettable clarity.

requiredObjects.object: gigantic radiant golden sun with calm face
joyful child rider
luminous pearl-white horse
billowing scarlet silk banner
large blooming sunflowers behind stone wall

promptSpec.compositionNote: Brightest high-key jewel in the deck: massive radiant gold sun orb crowning the top half above bright pearl-white horse, crisp scarlet diagonal banner, and four bold sunflowers—unmistakably joyous even at 64x96 thumbnail.

archetypeEssence.en: A decisive inner summons to rise into a larger life—answering truth without dragging old guilt along.
archetypeEssence.zh: 振聋发聩的内在召唤与自我觉醒——坦然清算旧账、放下愧疚，昂首迈入更开阔的人生阶段。

en: Monumental winged archangel parting bright clouds overhead sounding a long golden trumpet
Crisp white silk banner marked with a bold scarlet equal-armed cross hanging from the trumpet
Radiant sound-rays fanning downward across calm open waters toward distant icy mountains
Awakened figures rising with outstretched arms from open stone caskets floating on the sea
Expressions of unburdened release and joyous readiness answering the clear call
zh: 拨开高空云海、吹响修长金色号角的宏伟展翼大天使
垂挂于号角之下、饰有鲜明红色等臂十字的素白旗帜
自号口倾泻而下、照彻宁静海面与远方雪峰的金色声浪光束
从海上敞开的石棺中张开双臂起身的苏醒众人
卸下过往重负、神情释然且欣然回应召唤的觉醒姿态

en: Grand Belle Epoque archangel with sweeping crimson-and-gold feathered wings emerging from parted midnight-indigo clouds
Long gleaming antique-gold trumpet sounded downward draped with a crisp pearl-ivory pennant bearing an equal-armed scarlet cross
Straight golden-ivory rays of awakening light fanning across a serene star-reflected sapphire bay and distant snow-capped peaks
Three awakened human figures draped in luminous translucent ivory shrouds rising with outstretched arms from open pale-limestone sea caskets
High-contrast celestial illumination uniting scarlet-gold heavens above with radiant emerging silhouettes below
zh: 拨开深蓝云层、展开绯红鎏金宏伟双翼的美好年代大天使
向下吹响的修长古金号角与悬垂其上的珠白红十字丝幡
如乐音般洒满星光蓝海与远方皑皑雪峰的笔直金色觉醒光束
披着莹白轻纱、从海中敞开浅石棺里伸展双臂起身的三位苏醒者
上下呼应、将天界绯金辉光与海面新生剪影融为一体的壮阔明暗格局

core.en: Judgement is not a courtroom sentence—it is a wake-up trumpet. Take clear, merciful stock of what past chapters taught you, forgive what kept you small, and answer the larger calling that has been knocking unmistakably at your door.
core.zh: 审判不是冰冷定罪，而是唤醒沉睡的号角。清醒而仁慈地盘点过往每一段历练，宽恕那些曾把你困在窄处的旧错，然后干脆回应门外那声已清晰响起的更高召唤。

message.en: Answer the call you can no longer unhear—own your past cleanly, release old shame, and step up to the bigger role ready for you.
message.zh: 回应那声你已再也装作听不见的内在召唤——坦然整合过往、卸下陈旧愧疚，站上早已为你敞开的更大舞台。

foundation.en: A pivotal reckoning, honest milestone review, or wake-up realization shook loose old sleepwalking and sparked this new chapter.
foundation.zh: 一次关键的自我清算、重要节点复盘或醍醐灌顶的顿悟，摇醒了过往惯性，开启了当下的新局面。

present.en: You are standing in a clear moment of evaluation and graduation: past efforts are being tallied honestly, and a fresh tier of purpose is opening.
present.zh: 你正处在一场清晰的阶段考核与跃升关口：过往积累正被如实检阅，更高一层的人生格局正在面前展开。

challenge.en: Outgrowing an old self-image takes nerve, and that is the test here: rising means letting past critics and old excuses stay behind in the box.
challenge.zh: 挣脱旧的自我定位需要胆识，考验正在于此——起身迎新，就得把过往的标签、苛责与借口留在旧盒子里。

resource.en: Your strongest asset is redeemed experience—nothing you survived was wasted once you integrate its lesson and let it fuel your calling.
resource.zh: 你最厚重的资本是历经锤炼且被真正消化的阅历——凡是走过的弯路，只要提炼出真知，全都会成为托举你跃升的底气。

action.en: Make the decisive call you have been circling, forgive one lingering self-reproach, and step openly into the next chapter with both arms lifted.
action.zh: 做出那个你已反复盘旋的关键抉择，正式原谅自己一桩耿耿于怀的旧憾，张开双臂坦然迈入下一程。

outcome.en: Answering the call tends to lead toward profound renewal, absolution, and a clean graduation into a truer life stage, where you are likely to feel lighter, clearer, and deeply aligned.
outcome.zh: 回应这声召唤，多半通向深沉的焕新、彻底的释怀与顺理成章的进阶——你很可能以更轻盈、更笃定的姿态踏入更真实的人生阶段。

advice.en: Judge your past to harvest wisdom, never to sentence your future—rise when the trumpet sounds.
advice.zh: 复盘过往是为了提炼智慧，绝不是为了替未来判刑——号角已经响起，果断起身迎光。

hidden.en: An old chapter may be asking to be reviewed before you can move on—a regret, an unanswered apology, or a talent you shelved. Check what keeps resurfacing; it may be the call itself.
hidden.zh: 可能有一段旧章节正等着被重新过目，你才走得动：一桩遗憾、一句没回应的道歉，或一项被你束之高阁的本事。看看是什么总在反复冒出来，那可能就是召唤本身。

self.en: You come to this awake and ready to account for yourself: honest about the past, done with excuses, willing to be seen changing. You bring the courage to say the old version of you is finished.
self.zh: 你来到这件事里时是清醒的，也准备好为自己交代：对过去诚实，不再找借口，也不怕被人看见自己在变。你带来的，是敢说“从前那个我到此为止”的勇气。

other.en: The other person may be reassessing everything, and appears ready to speak honestly about the past or make a clear decision. They are likely to be direct, and may give the answer you have been waiting on.
other.zh: 对方可能正在把一切重新盘点，看上去已准备好坦率谈谈过去，或做出明确的决定。他们多半会直说，也许正是你等了很久的那个答复。

external.en: A moment of review has arrived from outside: results announced, a decision handed down, an invitation that asks for a yes or no. The timing is being set by the call, not by your readiness.
external.zh: 一个从外部到来的检阅时刻：结果公布、决定下达，或一份需要你明确表态的邀请。时间由这声召唤来定，而不是由你准备得如何来定。

hopes_fears.en: You hope to be forgiven, recognized, and given a real second chance, yet fear being weighed and found lacking, or having to live up to the calling once you answer it.
hopes_fears.zh: 你盼着被原谅、被认可，得到一次真正的重来机会，却又怕被掂量之后发现不够格，也怕一旦应了这声召唤，就得真的担得起它。

general.en: Awakening, honest integration, and a defining call to grow mark this moment. Release outdated guilt and step wholeheartedly into what comes next.
general.zh: 觉醒、诚实整合与标志性的成长召唤正落在此刻。放下过时的内疚包袱，全心跨入人生的下一段开阔格局。

love.en: In love, Judgement brings a decisive turning point—honest forgiveness and true rebirth inside a committed bond, or waking clearly to the kind of partnership your whole self actually deserves.
love.zh: 在感情中，审判标志关系迎来清晰分水岭——要么在彻底坦白与宽恕中获得重生升级，要么彻底醒悟，奔向真正配得上你完整灵魂的伴侣模式。

career.en: At work, this signals a true vocational calling, promotion review, graduation, or decisive leap from 'just a job' into work that carries unmistakable personal meaning.
career.zh: 在事业上，它呼应真正的志业召唤、关键晋升评审、阶段出师，或从单纯谋生果断跃迁向真正有个人分量的事业轨道。

health.en: For wellbeing, a wake-up realization sparks lasting renewal—dropping old self-neglect cleanly and committing to vital living without looking back.
health.zh: 在身心层面，一次彻底清醒的顿悟会开启持久焕新——干脆告别旧日消耗惯性，不留恋地拥抱更有生命力的日常。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, this is genuine resurrection of purpose: answering conscience wholeheartedly and discovering grace through honest self-forgiveness.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，这是初心与使命的真正复活：毫无保留地回应内在良知，并在诚实的自我宽恕里体会真正的松绑。

core.en: Judgement reversed shows the call being put on snooze—harsh inner self-criticism, fear of being judged by others, or stubbornly ignoring a wake-up signal you already heard loud and clear.
core.zh: 审判逆位映照出把唤醒闹钟一再按掉的回避——严苛的自我批判、过度在意他人评判，或明明早已听清转折信号却仍迟疑着不肯起身。

blocked.en: Self-doubt and fear of making the wrong call keep you crouching inside an outgrown box.
blocked.zh: 自我怀疑与怕选错的包袱，把你死死按在早已装不下自己的旧格子里。

excess.en: Relentless self-condemnation or nitpicking everyone else's flaws to dodge your own next step.
excess.zh: 没完没了地自我审判，或盯着旁人毛病评头论足，借此逃避自己该迈出的下一步。

internalized.en: Privately hearing the pull toward a bigger life while telling yourself you missed your window.
internalized.zh: 心里明明一遍遍听见更大人生的召唤，嘴上却不断告诉自己已经错过窗口。

release.en: Silencing the harsh inner prosecutor so honest self-compassion finally lets you move forward.
release.zh: 让内心那个尖刻的检察官闭嘴，在温和坦诚的自我接纳里重新迈开脚步。

message.en: You have heard the call; the delay is in answering it. Put down the case against yourself long enough to take the step, because the window is probably wider than your doubt claims.
message.zh: 那声召唤你已经听见了，拖着的只是回应。先把对自己的指控放下片刻，好迈出那一步——那扇窗多半比你的自我怀疑所说的更宽。

foundation.en: An old mistake that was never forgiven, or a chance you believe you missed, has been running in the background. Your hesitation now traces back to that unfinished verdict.
foundation.zh: 一桩始终没被原谅的旧错，或一次你认定自己错过的机会，一直在后台运转。你如今的迟疑，可以追溯到那份没有结案的判决。

present.en: You are hitting snooze: aware that something is asking you to step up, and answering with self-criticism, comparison, or one more reason to wait.
present.zh: 你正在一遍遍按掉闹钟：明知有什么在叫你站出来，回应它的却是自我批评、和别人比较，或又一个“还不是时候”的理由。

challenge.en: Chronic self-doubt, old regret, or fear of outside judgment is drowning out a clear inner invitation.
challenge.zh: 挥之不去的自我怀疑、陈年懊悔或对旁人眼光的畏惧，正盖过内心原本清亮的召唤。

resource.en: Your conscience works, perhaps too loudly, and it shows you care about getting this right. Turn its volume down and what remains is an honest record of what you have learned and a call still on the line.
resource.zh: 你的良知是管用的，也许只是声音太大，这说明你在乎把事情做对。把音量调低，剩下的就是一份如实的成长记录，和一通还没挂断的来电。

action.en: Write down the mistake you keep replaying, extract its single practical lesson, forgive yourself formally, and answer the opportunity you have been dodging.
action.zh: 写下那件你总在心里反复翻旧账的失误，只提炼出一条实在教训，正式翻篇宽恕自己，再去回应那个你一直闪躲的机会。

outcome.en: Hesitation tends only to stretch the waiting room; if you stop rehearsing old guilt, the stalled breakthrough is likely to unlock.
outcome.zh: 犹豫多半只会拉长原地打转的候场时间；若能停止拿旧账惩罚自己，停滞的突破很可能就此松动打开。

advice.en: Stop waiting for perfect absolution from outside critics—your real calling does not expire just because you stumbled earlier.
advice.zh: 别再等外界评委给你发完美通行证——你真正想走的路，绝不会因为从前跌过一跤就作废。

hidden.en: Ask whether the criticism, of yourself or of everyone else, is a way to avoid the next step. Beneath it there may be a belief that you are too late, and that belief has not been tested.
hidden.zh: 问一问这些批评——对自己的，或对所有人的——是不是在帮你躲开下一步。它底下可能有一个“我已经太晚了”的念头，而这个念头并没有被检验过。

self.en: You are acting as your own harshest critic, replaying the evidence against you and bracing for what others will say. That stance keeps you smaller than the facts require.
self.zh: 你正充当自己最严厉的批评者，把对自己不利的证据一遍遍重放，同时提防着别人会怎么说。这个姿态，把你压得比事实需要的更小。

other.en: They may be quick to criticize or slow to commit, and appear to be weighed down by their own unfinished past. Harsh words from them are likely to say as much about that as about you.
other.zh: 对方可能动辄挑剔，或迟迟不肯表态，看上去像是被自己没了结的过去拖着。他们说出的重话，多半既关乎你，也关乎那段过去。

external.en: The atmosphere is judgmental or stalled: a review that keeps being deferred, an audience quick to find fault, old history brought up again. Outside opinion is loud at present, though not all of it is binding.
external.zh: 外部的气氛要么充满评判，要么停滞不前：一场迟迟不落定的评审、一群爱挑毛病的看客，或被重新翻出来的旧账。眼下外界的声音很响，却并非句句都算数。

hopes_fears.en: What you hope to hear is that it is not too late and you are forgiven; what you fear is answering the call and being judged for it, or finding you really did miss your moment.
hopes_fears.zh: 你想听到的是“还不算晚，你已经被原谅了”；你怕的是回应了召唤反被人评头论足，或发现自己真的错过了时机。

general.en: Notice where harsh self-judgment or fear of scrutiny is holding back an overdue leap. Drop old guilt and answer your honest next step.
general.zh: 觉察严苛的自审或对他人评价的担忧，正把哪场早该启动的跃迁按在原地。放下陈旧愧疚，诚实回应下一个阶段。

love.en: In love, reversed Judgement warns against replaying past heartbreaks as permanent verdicts, nitpicking a partner, or avoiding a candid decision about a relationship's true viability.
love.zh: 在感情中，审判逆位提醒别把过往情伤当成终身定论、也别在琐碎挑剔中消耗彼此，更不要继续回避对关系前景的诚实判断。

career.en: At work, imposter syndrome, fear of evaluation, or ignoring clear feedback that a chapter has peaked stalls advancement. Take honest notes without personalizing critique.
career.zh: 在职场上，冒牌者心理、畏惧考核，或回避“某段路径已到天花板”的清晰反馈，都会拖住跃升。客观吸收建议，别把业务复盘变成自我否定。

health.en: Ignoring persistent wake-up signals—or beating yourself up for past slips—slows recovery; drop the guilt and start clean from today.
health.zh: 在身心层面，无视身体反复发出的提醒，或为过去疏于照顾自己而苛责懊恼，都会拖慢复原；放下自责，从今天清爽重启。

spirituality.en: Forgiveness is the missing hinge: no genuine awakening grows out of self-contempt.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，对自己与过往的宽恕正是那枚缺失的枢纽：真正的内在觉醒从来不会从无休止的自我嫌弃里长出来。

promptSpec.suitAccent: radiant celestial gold, crimson-scarlet wings and cross, luminous pearl-ivory, deep sapphire sea, velvety midnight-indigo zenith
promptSpec.scene: Parting dramatic midnight-indigo and gilded clouds across the upper sky rises ONE monumental Belle Epoque archangel with sweeping crimson-and-burnished-gold feathered wings, lifting ONE gleaming long antique-gold trumpet draped cleanly with a crisp pearl-ivory silk pennant bearing an equal-armed scarlet cross. Radiant straight rays of golden-ivory light fan downward from the trumpet bell across a serene, star-reflected sapphire bay backed by pale snow-capped mountain peaks along the distant horizon. Rising joyfully with outstretched arms from THREE open pale-limestone caskets floating gently on the luminous sea are THREE awakened human figures draped in soft translucent pearl-ivory shrouds—a woman, a man, and a youth—faces lifted skyward in luminous release and wonder. Crisp golden illumination ties the majestic winged archangel above directly to the radiant rising figures below with unmistakable vertical grandeur.

requiredObjects.object: winged celestial archangel emerging from upper clouds
long golden trumpet draped with scarlet-cross ivory pennant
awakened rising human figures in open sea caskets

promptSpec.compositionNote: Grand vertical call-and-response: crimson-gold winged archangel and bright vertical golden trumpet filling the upper half above glowing golden rays and three outstretched rising ivory silhouettes below—reads vividly at 64x96 thumbnail.

archetypeEssence.en: Integrated wholeness—completing a full spiral with mastery, grace, and readiness for wider horizons.
archetypeEssence.zh: 浑然圆融的整全与大成——以从容驾驭收束一整轮历程，坦然面向更辽阔的新螺旋。

en: Serene dancing figure poised weightlessly at the center of a great oval laurel wreath
Lush emerald victory wreath tied top and bottom with flowing crimson infinity ribbons
Lightweight silk scarf draping gracefully across the dancer's balanced silhouette
A short slender baton held evenly in each hand signifying equilibrium in motion
Four cloud-borne corner emblems—man, eagle, bull, and lion—framing the completed cosmos
zh: 凌空舒展、轻盈起舞于巨型椭圆月桂花环中央的从容舞者
上下两端皆系着绯红无限结丝带的繁茂翠绿胜利花环
随舞姿优雅拂过身侧的飘逸轻纱
双手各执一根纤细权杖，象征动静平衡与圆融掌控
镇守四隅云端、象征四元素圆满归位的人面、苍鹰、圣牛与雄狮

en: Radiant Belle Epoque dancer floating weightlessly inside a luminous halo at the center of a starry midnight-indigo firmament
Grand oval Art Nouveau wreath woven from lustrous emerald laurel leaves and gilded berries, bound top and bottom with sweeping scarlet-crimson silk infinity ribbons
Billowing royal-amethyst and pearl-ivory silk scarf draped gracefully across the dancer holding exactly two slender burnished-gold equilibrium batons
Four serene winged celestial corner emblems—angel, eagle, winged bull, and winged lion—framed symmetrically inside golden cloud medallions
Radiant ivory-gold central aura contrasting opulently against deep cosmic midnight indigo and emerald laurel foliage
zh: 在深邃星穹中央暖金光晕中轻盈旋舞的美好年代舞者
由光泽饱满的祖母绿月桂叶与鎏金浆果编成、上下系有绯红丝绸无限结的宏伟椭圆花环
身披紫晶与月白流动丝巾、双手各轻握一根古金平衡短杖的舒展身姿
对称镶嵌在四角暖金云纹徽章中的四尊展翼星界圣灵（天使、苍鹰、翼牛、翼狮）
在深沉星夜靛青与翠绿月桂间璀璨绽放的象牙金圆满光辉

core.en: The World marks genuine completion: the disparate lessons of a long cycle have finally clicked into one coherent whole. Honor the milestone fully, take a bow with quiet pride, and know you are ready to step into a much larger arena.
core.zh: 世界标志货真价实的圆满收官：漫长历程里散落各处的功课终于严丝合缝地汇成整体。郑重致敬这份里程碑、从容收下应得的喝彩，你已具备踏入更广阔世界舞台的完整底气。

message.en: Finish the final seam cleanly and claim your graduation—this chapter is genuinely complete, and wider doors are already swinging open.
message.zh: 把最后一道收尾稳稳做圆，大方认领你的出师时刻——这一程已真正圆满，更广阔的门正为你敞开。

foundation.en: Broad experience, completed past cycles, or hard-won integration across multiple areas built the mastery you stand on now.
foundation.zh: 丰富的跨界历练、圆满收官的过往周期，以及多方经验的融会贯通，共同托起了如今的从容底气。

present.en: Pieces are clicking cleanly into place; you are experiencing real wholeness, global perspective, and satisfying closure on a major endeavor.
present.zh: 所有拼图正严丝合缝地归位；你正体会着难得的整全感、辽阔视野，以及重要长线事项圆满合拢的踏实。

challenge.en: A quiet vertigo follows the finish of a big chapter; the trap is lingering to polish an already complete work just to avoid beginning the next spiral.
challenge.zh: 大篇章收官之后，难免有一丝微妙的悬空感；陷阱在于反复擦拭一件早已圆满的作品，只为躲开下一程的开始。

resource.en: Your strongest asset is panoramic synthesis—combining intellect, heart, willpower, and craft seamlessly so you feel at home anywhere.
resource.zh: 你最强的底气是全局融通力——把理智、共情、意志与实操无缝合一，无论走到哪片天地都能游刃有余。

action.en: Ship the final deliverable, celebrate the full journey deliberately, and orient toward broader horizons—travel, international collaboration, or a bigger scope.
action.zh: 把最终成果正式交付封卷，郑重庆祝这一整段旅程，随后把目光投向更宽广的版图——远行、跨国合作或更大的格局。

outcome.en: This course tends toward fulfillment, well-earned mastery, and harmonious completion—a meaningful era likely to close with poise and open the gateway to a richer next cycle.
outcome.zh: 照此走下去，多半迎来丰盈圆满、实至名归的掌控感与优雅收官——一段重要岁月有望从容合卷，并为更丰盛的新周期打开大门。

advice.en: Move like the dancer inside the wreath: stay light on your feet even at the summit, because mastery is an ongoing rhythm rather than a static trophy.
advice.zh: 像花环中央轻盈起舞的人一样保持灵动：即便站上巅峰也不僵硬自满，真正的圆满是生生不息的流转，而非停步不前的奖杯。

hidden.en: You may have outgrown the frame you are still measuring yourself by. Check whether the question has already been answered by everything you have completed, and whether a wider one is now waiting.
hidden.zh: 你可能已经长出了那个仍被你拿来衡量自己的框架。看一看这个问题是否早已被你完成的一切回答了，是否有一个更大的问题正在等你。

self.en: You stand in this whole and unhurried, with the experience to see the full picture and nothing left to prove on this ground. You bring competence, ease, and a sense that this round is properly finished.
self.zh: 你是完整而从容地站在这件事里的：有看清全貌的阅历，在这片场地上也不再需要证明什么。你带来的是胜任、松弛，以及“这一轮确实做完了”的那份踏实。

other.en: The other person appears settled and complete in themselves, and may be ready for a bigger step or a wider commitment. They are likely to meet you as an equal, with little need for you to fill a gap.
other.zh: 对方看起来自洽而完整，可能已准备好迈出更大的一步，或作出范围更广的承诺。他们多半会以对等的姿态面对你，并不需要你去填补什么空缺。

external.en: The wider setting is ready: a project signed off, doors opening further afield, the right people in the right places. Conditions outside you have come together and support a move to a larger stage.
external.zh: 更大的环境已经就绪：项目验收通过，更远处的门正在打开，合适的人也都在合适的位置。外部条件已经凑齐，足以支持你走向更大的舞台。

hopes_fears.en: You hope to reach the point where it all comes together and you can say it is done, yet fear the ending itself: the blank after the applause, and beginning again as a novice.
hopes_fears.zh: 你盼着走到一切合拢、可以说一句“完成了”的那一刻，却又怕结束本身：掌声之后的空白，以及又要从新手做起。

general.en: Wholeness, completion, and expanded horizons crown this period. Tie up the final ribbon cleanly, savor what you achieved, and welcome a wider world.
general.zh: 整全、大成与辽阔新视野为这段时期加冕。利落系好最后一道收尾丝带，坦然享受所成，从容步入更宽广的天地。

love.en: In love, The World speaks of deep mutual fulfillment, feeling genuinely 'home' with each other, or completing an important chapter together—long-distance bridging, shared travel, or mature harmony.
love.zh: 在感情中，世界象征高度契合的归属感与“彼此即是归宿”的安稳圆融——或共同完成人生重要里程碑，跨越距离、同行远方，在成熟默契里相得益彰。

career.en: At work, expect major project completion, international or cross-market reach, formal graduation, or stepping into full mastery of your craft. Package the finished body of work boldly.
career.zh: 在事业上，预示重大项目圆满上线、跨地域或国际化拓展、学业与阶段大考出师，或彻底站稳行业纯熟高度。自信呈现你的完整代表作。

health.en: For wellbeing, mind, body, and daily rhythm feel genuinely integrated—vitality thrives through balanced whole-life stewardship and joyful active movement.
health.zh: 在身心层面，身心节律与生活秩序进入圆融顺畅的整合态——全盘均衡的养护与愉悦舒展的活动让生命力饱满通透。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, integration arrives not by escaping the world but by dancing cleanly inside it—belonging to the whole cosmos with humility and delight.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，真正的圆融不在抽离尘世，而在万象之中轻盈起舞——怀着谦卑与喜悦，体会自己本就与广阔天地浑然一体。

core.en: The World reversed signals an almost-finished cycle missing its final 5%—leaving loose ends untied, cutting corners at the finish line, or hesitating to declare an era done.
core.zh: 世界逆位提示一整轮历程恰恰停在最后百分之五的收口处——留着没扎紧的线头、临门一脚略显草率，或因迟疑而不敢正式宣布这一章彻底完结。

blocked.en: An unfinished detail or lingering tie keeps a major chapter from closing cleanly.
blocked.zh: 一处悬而未决的细节或未了牵挂，卡住了整段重要周期的利落收尾。

excess.en: Skipping final closure out of impatience to sprint straight into the next shiny project.
excess.zh: 急着冲向下一个新鲜目标，草草略过了本该郑重完成的收口与复盘。

internalized.en: Downplaying real accomplishments because the last tiny flaw looms larger in your head than the whole journey.
internalized.zh: 紧盯着最后那一点微小瑕疵，反而抹杀了整趟长途积累下来的真实成就。

release.en: Tying off the final loose thread consciously so delayed completion finally lands in peace.
release.zh: 有意识地把最后那根散落线头亲手系紧，让迟到的圆满终于安稳落地。

message.en: You are nearly there, and nearly is the issue. Name what is still open—a task, a conversation, a goodbye—and give it the same care you gave the beginning.
message.zh: 你差一点就到了，问题恰恰出在“差一点”。说出还敞着口的是什么——一项任务、一场谈话，还是一句告别——然后拿出当初开头时的那份用心去对待它。

foundation.en: An earlier chapter was left slightly open: a project dropped near the end, a move made before the last matter was settled. That missing close still tugs at what you are doing now.
foundation.zh: 之前有一章留了一道缝没合上：一个临近尾声被放下的项目，或一次在最后一件事还没了结时就做出的转身。那个缺掉的收尾，至今还牵扯着你现在做的事。

present.en: Most of the work is done and the last stretch is dragging. Loose ends sit unattended while your attention drifts to the next thing, or to the one flaw that spoils the view for you.
present.zh: 大部分工作已经完成，最后一段却拖着不动。线头搁在那里没人管，你的注意力不是飘向下一件事，就是盯着那个让你觉得煞风景的小瑕疵。

challenge.en: Unfinished business, shortcuts on the final stretch, or reluctance to close an old loop is blocking full satisfaction.
challenge.zh: 未清的收尾事项、冲线前的偷懒抄近路，或不肯为旧周期合卷，正拦着你体会真正的圆满感。

resource.en: Nearly all of it is built and none of that is lost. What is left is small and specific, and you already have every skill needed to finish it.
resource.zh: 绝大部分已经建成，这些一点都不会丢。剩下的部分又小又具体，而收尾所需的每一样本事，你都早已具备。

action.en: List the exact two or three remaining loose ends today and close them completely—no shortcuts—before starting anything brand new.
action.zh: 今天就列出最后剩下的两三处未了尾项，不走捷径地彻底收干净，之后再启新局。

outcome.en: Completion is still within arm's reach, waiting on patient follow-through; finishing the last inch properly is what tends to bring the whole reward.
outcome.zh: 圆满仍触手可及，只差耐心走完最后那一寸；踏实做好收口，整份成果的回馈才更可能完整到手。

advice.en: Respect the final five percent—clean closure honors everything you already invested and frees your hands for what comes next.
advice.zh: 敬重最后百分之五的收官功夫——干脆体面的闭环既不辜负此前的全部心血，也能彻底腾出双手迎接新世界。

hidden.en: Consider whether leaving it unfinished serves a purpose. An open ending can be a way to avoid being evaluated, or to avoid the question of what comes after.
hidden.zh: 想一想让它悬着是不是另有用处。不收尾，有时是为了躲开被人评价，或躲开“接下来做什么”这个问题。

self.en: You are the one at the ninety-five percent mark, impatient to move on or unable to call it good enough. You undersell what you have done because of what remains.
self.zh: 你是那个停在百分之九十五处的人：要么急着奔向下一件事，要么怎么都不肯说一句“这样就够好了”。因为还剩下的那一点，你把自己做成的事说小了。

other.en: They may be leaving things open-ended, slow to finalize or reluctant to call the matter settled. They appear to have one foot already elsewhere, so ask directly what remains to be closed on their side.
other.zh: 对方可能让事情一直悬而未决：迟迟不敲定，或不愿承认这件事已经了结。他们看上去一只脚已经迈向别处，不妨直接问清楚，他们那边还有什么没收尾。

external.en: Outside factors are holding up the finish: a sign-off still pending, a last document or approval outstanding, travel or timing that will not line up. The delay is logistical and near the end, not a reversal.
external.zh: 卡住收尾的是外部因素：一个还没批下来的签字、一份迟迟未到的文件，或怎么也对不上的行程与时间。这是临近终点的流程延误，并不是局面逆转。

hopes_fears.en: You hope to close this out properly and feel finished at last, yet fear that once it is complete it can be judged as a whole, and that nothing as absorbing will follow.
hopes_fears.zh: 你盼着把这件事好好收尾，终于能踏实地松一口气，却又怕做完就意味着它能被人整体评判，也怕之后再没有一件事能让自己这样投入。

general.en: You are nearly across the finish line, but a few untied threads still need attention. Finish cleanly rather than abandoning the work at ninety-five percent.
general.zh: 你离终点线只剩一步之遥，只是还有几处线头需要亲手收紧。别停在九十五分就急着转身，稳稳把最后一段画圆。

love.en: In love, reversed World flags unfinished emotional closure from an earlier chapter, or a relationship hovering right before deeper commitment until one lingering hesitation is addressed.
love.zh: 在感情中，世界逆位提示前段情感尚未彻底收尾，或眼下的关系正停在迈向更深承诺的门槛前，需要把那点悬着的心结坦诚理清。

career.en: At work, final QA, documentation, handoffs, or formal launch steps are overdue. Close the last mile thoroughly so the whole project earns its full credit.
career.zh: 在职场上，收尾验收、文档归档、交接或正式发布步骤早已到期。把最后一公里扎扎实实收完，整场心血才配得上完整口碑。

health.en: Stopping a recovery protocol the moment symptoms ease invites relapse; finish the complete course patiently so gains actually lock in.
health.zh: 在身心调理上，症状刚见好就中途停掉巩固方案容易反复；耐心走完完整周期，好状态才会真正稳固下来。

spirituality.en: Don't rush past gratitude and integration into the next quest; pause to name what this whole cycle actually taught you.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，别急着略过感恩与沉淀就奔赴下一场追寻；停下来认真说出这整轮经历究竟教会了你什么。

promptSpec.suitAccent: luminous emerald-laurel green, molten antique gold leaf, royal violet-crimson silk, moonlit pearl-ivory, deep celestial midnight-indigo
promptSpec.scene: Centered magnificently against a deep starry midnight-indigo firmament floats ONE grand oval Art Nouveau wreath woven from lustrous emerald laurel leaves and tiny gilded berries, bound crisply at both top and bottom with sweeping scarlet-crimson silk ribbons tied in graceful infinity loops. Poised weightlessly inside the brightly illuminated central oval dances ONE serene, radiant Belle Epoque figure draped in a flowing royal-amethyst and pearl-ivory silk scarf, one knee lightly bent in poised equilibrium while each hand grasps ONE slender burnished antique-gold equilibrium baton (two batons total). Resting symmetrically within glowing golden cloud-medallions at the four corners appear EXACTLY FOUR serene winged celestial emblems—an angel at upper-left, an eagle at upper-right, a winged bull at lower-left, and a winged lion at lower-right—completing the grand cosmic mandala. Brilliant ivory-gold halo light behind the dancer contrasts vividly against the emerald laurel ring and velvety cosmic indigo.

requiredObjects.object: serene dancing figure inside wreath
oval emerald laurel wreath tied top and bottom with crimson ribbons
slender golden equilibrium batons held in dancer's hands
winged celestial corner emblems in four corners
